programme.title: Żużel: PGE Ekstraliga - rewanżowy mecz finałowy fazy play-off: Betard Sparta Wrocław - PRES Grupa Deweloperska Toruń
programme.desc: Panowanie Motoru Lublin w Ekstralidze trwało trzy lata i dobiegło końca w 2025 roku za sprawą toruńskich Aniołów. Ekipa ta jest na dobrej drodze, by też zapisać się złotymi zgłoskami w annałach rodzimego żużla. Pierwsza część finałowego dwumeczu pomiędzy PRES-em Toruń i Spartą Wrocław rozpoczęła się z dwugodzinnym opóźnieniem z powodu opadów deszczu. Obie drużyny zrekompensowały jednak kibicom oczekiwanie i zafundowały im świetne widowisko. Ostatecznie gospodarze wygrali 55:35 i do stolicy Dolnego Śląska pojadą dopełnić dzieła. Szóste mistrzostwo Polski w historii klubu z Miasta Pierników jest więc na wyciągnięcie ręki Patryka Dudka i jego kolegów. W meczu na Motoarenie zawiódł zwłaszcza Maciej Janowski, który zdobył dla Sparty tylko 4 punkty. Doświadczony zawodnik w wywiadach nie ukrywał, że jego drużyna jest w bardzo trudnej sytuacji przed rewanżem. Ma jednak powody, by wierzyć w sukces swojej misji. W sezonie zasadniczym Wrocławianie ograli Torunian na Stadionie Olimpijskim 52:38. Ponadto w 2026 roku pozostają niepokonani przed własną publicznością. Przy znakomitej dyspozycji wszystkich żużlowców i odrobinie szczęścia są więc w stanie odwrócić losy finałowej rywalizacji i po pięcioletniej przerwie wrócić na ekstraligowy tron.

Byłem królem
programme.desc: Seria przybliżająca sylwetki najlepszych strzelców w historii piłkarskiej ekstraklasy. To wspaniała okazja do przypomnienia sobie sukcesów Włodzimierza Lubańskiego, Grzegorza Laty, Kazimierza Kmiecika, Grzegorza Piechny i Tomasza Frankowskiego. Poznamy różne piłkarskie pokolenia. W latach 60. XX wieku cztery raz z rzędu królem strzelców był Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze). Natomiast w latach 70. królowali Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) i Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec). W czasach bardziej współczesnych cztery tytuły na koncie zanotował Tomasz Frankowski w barwach Wisły Kraków i Jagiellonii Białystok. Nie zabraknie też historii Grzegorza Piechny, niespodziewanego króla strzelców z Korony Kielce w 2006 roku.

Liga włoska - mecz: Juventus FC - SS Lazio
programme.desc: Biancocelesti pod wodzą trenera Gennaro Gattuso zaliczyli najlepszy początek sezonu w swojej historii, inkasując trzynaście punktów w pierwszych pięciu kolejkach Serie A. Głodni sukcesu Rzymianie, którzy czekają na zdobycie scudetto już 26 lat, są na fali i nie mają zamiaru zwalniać tempa. To zła wiadomość dla Juventusu. Piłkarze Starej Damy pragną bowiem przełamać passę trzech meczów bez zwycięstwa przeciwko Lazio. By tego dokonać, w hicie siódmej kolejki muszą pokazać się z jeszcze lepszej strony niż w wygranym spotkaniu z Atalantą Bergamo (2:0) pod koniec września.

programme.desc: Biancocelesti pod wodzą trenera Gennaro Gattuso zaliczyli najlepszy początek sezonu w swojej historii, inkasując trzynaście punktów w pierwszych pięciu kolejkach Serie A. Głodni sukcesu Rzymianie, którzy czekają na zdobycie scudetto już 26 lat, są na fali i nie mają zamiaru zwalniać tempa. To zła wiadomość dla Juventusu. Piłkarze Starej Damy pragną bowiem przełamać passę trzech meczów bez zwycięstwa przeciwko Lazio. By tego dokonać, w hicie siódmej kolejki muszą pokazać się z jeszcze lepszej strony niż w wygranym spotkaniu z Atalantą Bergamo (2:0) pod koniec września.

Żużel: PGE Ekstraliga - mecz: Betard Sparta Wrocław - Stelmet Falubaz Zielona Góra
Byłem królem
programme.desc: Seria przybliżająca sylwetki najlepszych strzelców w historii piłkarskiej ekstraklasy. To wspaniała okazja do przypomnienia sobie sukcesów Włodzimierza Lubańskiego, Grzegorza Laty, Kazimierza Kmiecika, Grzegorza Piechny i Tomasza Frankowskiego. Poznamy różne piłkarskie pokolenia. W latach 60. XX wieku cztery raz z rzędu królem strzelców był Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze). Natomiast w latach 70. królowali Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) i Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec). W czasach bardziej współczesnych cztery tytuły na koncie zanotował Tomasz Frankowski w barwach Wisły Kraków i Jagiellonii Białystok. Nie zabraknie też historii Grzegorza Piechny, niespodziewanego króla strzelców z Korony Kielce w 2006 roku.

Carro da Polícia
programme.desc: Dois miúdos encontram um carro da polícia abandonado e decidem aprender a guiá-lo. Mas quando o corrupto xerife da cidade decide reavê-lo, os três envolvem-se numa corrida eletrizante onde vale tudo.

programme.title: Psico II
programme.desc: Vinte e dois anos depois do famoso homicídio de Marion Crane, Norman Bater é considerado são e é libertado, regressando ao seu motel dilapidado. Mas quando os homicídios recomeçam, Norman percebe que uma velha amiga aguarda o seu regresso, a mãe!

programme.title: Os Bad Boys
programme.desc: Um lote de heroína avaliada em cerca de 100 milhões de dólares é roubado do próprio depósito da polícia. O caso será encarregue aos agentes Burnett (Martin Lawrence) e Lowery (Will Smith), uma dupla muito peculiar pelos métodos que utilizam.

programme.title: O Massacre
programme.desc: Na sequência da morte do seu filho o chefe da polícia secreta de Chicago contrata um ex-agente para desmantelar a Mafia que opera naquela cidade.

programme.title: Confiança
programme.desc: A vida de Jake Vig pode depender do que não sabe. Este elegante jogador acaba de roubar milhares de dólares ao intocável Lionel Dolby. No entanto, quando Lionel e outro membro da equipa aparecem mortos, descobre-se que Lionel não é um homem qualquer.

programme.title: Passageiros
programme.desc: Uma nave espacial transporta milhares de pessoas para um planeta colônia, que tem uma avaria em uma de suas câmaras de sono.

programme.title: Dead Man Down Um Homem A Abater
programme.desc: Victor é o braço direito de Alphonse, o líder de uma organização criminosa que está a ser perseguido por alguém que vai matando os membros do seu gangue e lhe envia notas ameaçadoras.

programme.title: Para Além do Horizonte
programme.desc: Chirs e Annie não conseguiram superar a morte dos seus dois filhos ocorrida num acidente de viação. Quatro anos depois Chris também morre e descobre que o Céu existe e que é um grande lugar.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: John Rambo, hesita em acompanhar o velho amigo Coronel Trautman às linhas soviéticas no Afeganistão. Mas acabará por seguir, numa missão não-oficial de resgate na sequência da captura de Trautman.

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: Jackie Brown é uma hospedeira de bordo que se vê envolvida num jogo de traições e vigarice com a autoria de Ordell Robbe, um aspirante a traficante de armas que quer "resgatar" meio milhão de dólares que apresenta nos seus cofres do México.

programme.title: Greenberg
programme.desc: Ben Stiller é Greenberg - solteiro, de quarenta e tal anos, que nada faz deliberadamente - nesta comédia inteligente, engraçada e comovente que os críticos dizem ser extremamente divertida.

programme.title: A História de Whitney Houston
programme.desc: Este retrato complexo da incomparável Whitney Houston acompanha a ascensão da cantora desde menina do coro em Nova Jérsia até estrela internacional.

programme.title: Olha que duas
programme.desc: Nesta aventura hilariante, uma sonhadora impetuosa (Amy Schumer) e a sua ultracautelosa mãe (Goldie Hawn) têm de trabalhar em equipa para sobreviver quando as suas férias sofrem uma reviravolta inesperada.

programme.title: Boyhood: Momentos De Uma Vida
programme.desc: Após o divórcio, uma mãe e um pai continuam a tarefa partilhada de educar o seu filho mais novo através da adolescência e, finalmente, até à idade adulta.

programme.title: A Ilha das Cabeças Cortadas
programme.desc: Morgan, uma bonita pirata que navega sob as ordens de seu pai, decide partir em busca de um fabuloso tesouro indicado num mapa que este lhe entregou antes de morrer.

programme.title: Misteriosa Obsessão
programme.desc: Telly Paretta é uma mulher que luta por superar a perda do seu filho de oito anos. Um dia, seu psicoterapeuta diz-lhe que o seu filho não é mais que um produto da sua imaginação.

programme.title: Psico III
programme.desc: Logo agora que pensávamos que era seguro voltar a entrar no duche! O terror regressa quando uma freira foragida (Diana Scarwid) com as mesmas iniciais de Marion Crane procura abriga no Motel Bates, espoletando o instinto assassino de Norman.

programme.title: Rapaz A
programme.desc: Jack Burridge, um assassino de crianças condenado, encontra trabalho como estafeta. Um jornal local descobre o seu passado, e Jack vê-se confrontado com a raiva e o medo dos habitantes pela segurança dos seus filhos.

programme.title: Cães Danados
programme.desc: Joe Cabot (Lawrence Tierney), um experiente criminoso, reuniu seis bandidos para um grande roubo de diamantes, mas estes seis homens não sabem nada um sobre os outros e cada um utiliza uma cor como codinome.

programme.title: Acordado
programme.desc: Clay Beresford, é um jovem milionário que aparenta ter tudo - dinheiro, uma lindíssima mulher e uma carreira lucrativa - mas, o que mais precisa é de fazer o transplante de coração que poderá salvar-lhe a vida.

programme.title: Poderia Acontecer-te
programme.desc: Charlie Lange é um policía de bom coração, casado com uma mulher ambiciosa. Certo dia, num café e sem dinheiro para pagar, promete algo à empregada de mesa, Yvonne. Se ganhar o próximo sorteio da lotaria, dá-lhe metade.

programme.title: Kiss & Kill - Beijos & Balas
programme.desc: Quando Jen Kornfeldt decide ceder aos caprichos dos seus pais, aceitando juntar-se a eles numa longa viagem pela costa francesa, não imaginava como a sua vida seria alterada.

programme.title: Oficina do Diabo
programme.desc: Neste thriller sinistro protagonizado por Emile Hirsch e Radha Mitchell, um ator pede a uma demonóloga para ajudá-lo a conseguir um papel, e o seu fim de semana juntos irrompe em violência ritual.

programme.title: Prisioneiro
programme.desc: Stallone enfrenta a cadeia e um inimigo especial que pretende matá-lo: Donald Sutherland.

programme.title: O Coleccionador de Ossos
programme.desc: Um diabólico assassino anda à solta nas ruas de Manhattan. Os seus brutais homicídios deixam um rasto de mensagens em código escondidas no local do crime, pistas que somente uma mente brilhante pode resolver.

programme.title: Máquinas De Guerra
programme.desc: Num futuro próximo, uma experiência criou soldados invencíveis, a partir dos corpos de militares falecidos no terreno. Mas um dos soldados desumanizados tem recordações da sua vida anterior e irá escapar-se.

programme.title: Mare Vermelha
programme.desc: Depois do motim de uns rebeldes russos numa base com armamento nuclear, os Estados Unidos decidem enviar o submarino Alabama em missão de reconhecimento.

programme.title: O Massacre
programme.desc: Expulso do FBI, Mark Kaminsky é contratado pelo xerife de uma pequena cidade para matar o assassino do filho. Mas, para isso, Kaminsky tem de se infiltrar nos meandros da Máfia de Chicago.

programme.title: Sleepers - Sentimento de Revolta
programme.desc: Depois de uma partida terminar em tragédia, quatro amigos são enviados para um centro correcional, onde são brutalizados. Dez anos depois, já em liberdade, têm a oportunidade de se vingarem de quem lhes fez mal.

programme.title: Oficina do Diabo
programme.desc: Neste thriller sinistro protagonizado por Emile Hirsch e Radha Mitchell, um ator pede a uma demonóloga para ajudá-lo a conseguir um papel, e o seu fim de semana juntos irrompe em violência ritual.

programme.title: A Ilha das Cabeças Cortadas
programme.desc: Morgan, uma bonita pirata que navega sob as ordens de seu pai, decide partir em busca de um fabuloso tesouro indicado num mapa que este lhe entregou antes de morrer.

programme.title: Psico III

programme.title: O Universo no Olhar
programme.desc: Um biólogo molecular e o companheiro de laboratório descobrem evidências que podem alterar a sociedade tal como a conhecemos.

programme.title: Boyhood: Momentos de Uma Vida
programme.desc: Gravado ao longo de 12 anos, com o mesmo elenco, este projeto acompanha a vida do jovem Mason, dos seis aos 18 anos. Um miúdo como tantos outros que, aos poucos, emerge e segue o seu próprio caminho. Vencedor do Oscar® para Melhor Atriz Secundária em 2015.

programme.title: Pompeia
programme.desc: Milo, um gladiador de Pompeia, tenta resgatar a amada de um casamento negociado pelos pais dela. Uma luta contra o tempo, ameaçada pela erupção do monte Vesúvio, que destrói Pompeia à sua passagem.

programme.title: Psicopata Americano
programme.desc: Patrick Bateman é um jovem bem sucedido em Wall Street, mas também um serial killer que vagueia livremente e sem receios, em busca de uma nova vítima. Uma mente tenebrosa, capaz dos mais sórdidos crimes, protegido pela conformidade, e pela riqueza.

programme.title: A Malta do Bairro

programme.title: Passadeira Vermelha
programme.desc: "Passadeira Vermelha" faz a análise de tudo o que de importante se passou no mundo dos famosos e olha à lupa todas as suas ações. Os comentários não são consensuais e estão longe de ser pacíficos...

programme.title: Terra Brava
programme.desc: Diogo, um militar condecorado, descobre que Eduarda é a responsável pela destruição da sua família.

programme.title: Televendas
programme.desc: Aspiradores mais potentes do que o motor de um avião, colchões insufláveis, máquinas que transformam a flácida barriga em portentosos abdominais e mais, muito mais, à distância de um telefonema.

programme.title: Caminhos de Portugal
programme.desc: Com emissão aos sábados, "Caminhos de Portugal" convida os espectadores a embarcar numa viagem autêntica de norte a sul do país, à descoberta dos rostos que mantêm vivas as tradições, os ofícios e os saberes portugueses.

programme.title: Etnias
programme.desc: Liliana Campos apresenta o programa destinado às comunidades imigrantes. Etnias faz a divulgação de informações úteis para os estrangeiros que escolheram Portugal para viver e trabalhar, assim como notícias sobre os seus países de origem. No estúdio estão também convidados que debatem temas atuais.

programme.title: Edição Da Manhã
programme.desc: As notícias que marcam a atualidade em Portugal e no mundo, transmitidas num bloco de informação contínua.

programme.title: Alô Portugal
programme.desc: "Alô Portugal" já faz parte do dia a dia de muitos portugueses e lusófonos que não dispensam uma conversa descontraída e animada com José Figueiras! "Alô Portugal" é uma sala de estar e de conversar bem ao estilo do seu apresentador e dos seus ilustres convidados.

programme.title: E-Especial
programme.desc: O programa que lhe mostra todos os segredos de bastidores dos programas, dos atores, dos convidados e de todas as caras da SIC. Apresentado por Sofia Cerveira e Ricardo Pereira.

programme.title: Grandes Felinos 24/7
programme.desc: Acompanhe um grupo de grandes felinos africanos, dia e noite, durante seis meses. "Big Cats 24/7" proporcionará aos telespectadores uma visão sem precedentes da vida dos leões, leopardos e guepardos do impressionante Delta do Okavango, no Botswana.

programme.title: Primeiro Jornal
programme.desc: Toda a atualidade sobre as principais notícias do dia.

programme.title: Alta Definição
programme.desc: Daniel Oliveira conduz uma entrevista, numa abordagem intimista, num local especial escolhido pelo entrevistado. Gravado em Alta Definição, cada programa pretende ser um retrato biográfico do convidado/a, que é desafiado/a a apresentar-se sem maquilhagem, na sua mais pura essência.

programme.title: Talentos Em Grande
programme.desc: De norte a sul do país, pequenos artistas sobem ao palco para mostrar que o talento não é apenas para os adultos. Cantar, dançar, tocar instrumentos, fazer magia, contar anedotas, executar ginástica acrobática ou realizar feitos impressionantes como cálculo mental ou exercícios de memória.

programme.title: Jornal Da Noite
programme.desc: Apresenta as notícias mais importantes do dia em Portugal e no mundo, com reportagens, análises, entrevistas e os temas que marcam a atualidade nacional e internacional.

programme.title: Terra Nossa
programme.desc: Durante 48 horas César Mourão viaja até uma localidade para conhecer as tradições e curiosidades da terra, descobrir as principais figuras e ouvir as suas histórias. Tudo isto... sem rede e completamente improvisado.

programme.title: Casados À Primeira Vista
programme.desc: Pessoas solteiras cuidadosamente selecionadas - todas já tentaram tudo por tudo para encontrar o verdadeiro amor, sem sucesso - põe agora nas mãos deste formato o sonho de encontrar o amor das suas vidas.

programme.title: Um Voo Altamente

programme.title: Alô Portugal

programme.title: Casa Feliz - Especiais
programme.desc: Esta é a nossa casa! Por onde passam todas as nossas caras e milhares de portugueses! Casa cheia, casa animada, casa agitada, "Casa Feliz".

programme.title: Fama Show
programme.desc: Tendo por base os valores de qualidade associados à fama, cada uma das apresentadoras representa um sentido que dará uma orientação marcante em cada momento do programa. Recheado de rubricas originais, vamos poder ver as maiores estrelas nacionais e internacionais muito para além do que é comum.

programme.title: Víboras da Península Ibérica
programme.desc: Através de um extenso e pormenorizado percurso por Espanha e Portugal, iremos descobrir as três espécies de víboras que habitam a Península Ibérica.

Pistruiatul 2 - Ascunzișuri
programme.desc: Mihai, zis Pistruiatul, adaposteste un detinut politic evadat, care are nevoie de o locuinta conspirativa. Pistruiatul ia parte la misiune unde are surpriza sa-si intilneasca tatal si profesoara de istorie.

programme.title: Connect
programme.desc: Emisiunea Connect își propune să prezinte săptămânal cele mai noi și interesante gadgeturi, de la cele mai cunoscute telefoane, laptopuri, wearables, aplicații și jocuri, la cele mai inedite proiecte care țin capetele de afiș ale presei de tehnologie din toată lumea.

programme.title: Sănătate cu stil
programme.desc: Prezentatoarea emisiunii aduce în atenţia telespectatorilor o serie întreagă de afecţiuni, cu care se confruntă tot mai mulţi români, şi oferă cele mai bune soluţii şi remedii pentru acestea, cu ajutorul celor mai buni medici din România. Telespectatorii vor afla şi cum pot avea grija cel mai bine de sănătatea lor, cum se pot hrăni sănătos, ce beneficii aduce mişcarea în viaţa lor, cum pot trata cel mai bine afecţiuni de care le este teamă sau ruşine să vorbească, dar şi cum îşi pot asigura o stare de bine cu ajutorul leacurilor din natură, al plantelor care pot face adevărate miracole pentru sănătatea lor.

programme.title: Life & Style cu Maria Andrei
programme.desc: Emisiunea le propune telespectatorilor să redescopere destinații bine cunoscute, dar și rute alternative, să cunoască oameni deosebiți și să le afle poveștile, rețetele gastronomice și produsele locale premiate. Maria Andrei mai aduce în atenția publicului știri pertinente și autentice cu ajutorul unor specialiști respectați, și îi ajută să fie la curent cu ultimele tendințe în domeniul life & style.

programme.title: Iancu Jianul, zapciul
Iancu Jianu, zapciul
programme.desc: Fiul de boier Iancu slujeşte cinstit domnia ca zapciu. Când haiducul Mereanu fură caravanele cu aur ale lui Caragea, asprul şi neîndurătorul Iancu se îngrijeşte ca nimeni să nu încalce legea.

programme.title: Schimb de mame
programme.desc: Emisiunea "Schimb de mame" aduce în prim plan experienţele inedite trăite de soțiile-mame care au curajul să își schimbe viaţa pentru șapte zile. În fiecare săptămînă, două soții-mame vor face "schimb de vieți", vor avea o familie, prieteni și o slujbă complet noi, într-o localitate și o casa cu totul necunoscute. La final, protagoniștii se vor întâlni pentru a-și împărtăși experienţele trăite în răstimpul celor șapte zile și vor fi premiați.

programme.title: Atunci i-am condamnat pe toți la moarte
programme.desc: Ipu (Amza Pellea), nebunul satului, traieste ultimele zile ale ocupatiei germane. El e apropiat de un baiat. Dupa ce un militar neamt e ucis, localnicii sunt amenintati cu executia daca nu-l predau pe vinovat. Ipu accepta sa-si asume crima.

programme.title: Elisa
Elisa di Rivombrosa
programme.desc:
Frumoasa Elisa Scalzi, dama de companie
a contesei Ristori, se îndrăgosteşte de fiul acesteia, Fabrizio. Din
păcate, diferenţa mare de rang şi de avere face imposibilă căsătoria
celor doi tineri. Intrigile familiei îi vor pune la încercare pe Elisa
şi Fabrizio, care vor trece prin nenumărate aventuri până să-şi
găsească fericirea. Dar, în cele din urmă, în ciuda diferenţelor
sociale şi a imixtiunilor celor răuvoitori, dragostea va iesi
triumfătoare.

programme.title: Sclava Isaura
A Escrava Isaura
programme.desc: Remake dupa cunoscuta serie din 1976, serialul se constituie intr-o tumultoasa istorie a vietii sclavei Isaura, o tanara de culoare alba.\n\nNascuta in 1885, la ferma comandantului Almeida din Campos, tanara Isaura este fiica frumoasei sclave Juliana si a administratorului fermei Miguel. Viata Isaurei la ferma devine din ce in ce mai dificila, cand Leoncio, fiul lui Alemida, se intoarce acasa. Acesta se indragosteste nebuneste de Isaura!

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship with consequences that could change the world as he knows it. Horror sequel, starring Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams.

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May.

programme.title: Sick
programme.desc: Due to the pandemic, Parker and her best friend decide to quarantine at the family lake house alone - or so they think. Horror, starring Gideon Adlon, Bethlehem Million and Dylan Spradberry.

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five students staying in a remote cabin find an ancient magical book, and unwittingly unleash evil spirits on the world. The dark forces they have conjured up possess them one by one, transforming them into ravenous zombies with an insatiable desire to feast on the living. Sam Raimi's horror, starring Bruce Campbell and Ellen Sandweiss.

programme.title: The Damned
programme.desc: A 19th-century widow must make an unimaginable choice when, during a cruel winter, a foreign ship sinks off the coast of her fishing village. Horror mystery, starring Odessa Young, Joe Cole, Siobhan Finneran and Rory McCann.

programme.title: Ick
programme.desc: A science teacher's life changes when he reconnects with his first love and suspects a new student is his daughter, all while facing an alien threat in their town. Sci-fi comedy drama, starring Brandon Routh, Mena Suvari and Malina Pauli Weissman.

programme.title: The Craft
programme.desc: A new girl who finds it difficult to fit in at school befriends three goth misfits, who discover they can perform magic and form a secret coven. They initially use their powers for self-improvement, but eventually start to turn against their classmates, driving the ringleader insane as her lust for power takes over. Horror, starring Robin Tunney, Fairuza Balk, Neve Campbell, Rachel True and Skeet Ulrich.

programme.title: The Bride!
programme.desc: In 1930s Chicago, maverick scientist Dr Euphronius gives life to a murdered woman, sparking romance, police interest and radical change. Writer/director Maggie Gyllenhaal's horror based on The Bride of Frankenstein, starring Jessie Buckley, Christian Bale and Annette Bening.

programme.title: Final Destination: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Fifty-five years after her grandparents are involved in a disaster involving a restaurant tower, college student Stefani Reyes is plagued by recurring nightmares of the incident, and returns home seeking answers. The sixth entry in the supernatural horror saga, starring Kaitlyn Santa Juana, Teo Briones and Richard Harmon.

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: In 1838 Germany, Thomas Hutter is sent to the Carpathian mountains to secure the signature of enigmatic nobleman Count Orlok on a property sale in the German city of Wisborg. Thomas leaves his bride Ellen in the care of friend Friedrich Harding and his wife Anna. The young man barely survives the exhausting trip to Europe and stumbles home to find Ellen driven to delirium by a telepathic bond to the Count. Director Robert Eggers' version of the Dracula-inspired horror, starring Bill Skarsgard, Lily-Rose Depp, Nicholas Hoult and Aaron Taylor-Johnson.

programme.title: 28 Years Later
programme.desc: Decades since the rage virus took hold, the survivors live on a small island. When one of the group leaves on a mission into the mainland, he discovers secrets, wonders, and horrors that have mutated not only the infected but other survivors. Danny Boyle's horror thriller sequel, starring Jodie Comer, Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Ralph Fiennes and Rocco Haynes.

programme.title: Five Nights At Freddy's 2
programme.desc: One year after the supernatural nightmare at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, Mike and Vanessa are pulled back into a terrifying series of events. Horror sequel, starring Josh Hutcherson and Elizabeth Lail.

programme.title: Shaun of the Dead
programme.desc: An unambitious 29-year-old man recently dumped and trapped in the job from hell decides to get his life back on track. Unfortunately, he has to put his plans on hold when zombies rise from their graves and stalk the streets of London to feast on the living. Comedy horror, starring Simon Pegg, Nick Frost, Kate Ashfield, Dylan Moran, Lucy Davis, Bill Nighy and Penelope Wilton.

programme.title: Black Phone 2
programme.desc: Four years after a serial killer prowled the streets of North Denver, posing as a magician to lure unsuspecting children into the back of his van, teenager Finney tries to adjust to a normal life. However, the lethal Grabber returns, and is bent on revenge. Horror thriller, starring Ethan Hawke and Mason Thames.

programme.title: Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five friends travel to a remote woodland cabin, hoping one of them can conquer her drug addiction by going cold turkey. They uncover a mysterious book that, when read, unleashes demonic forces that possess the living and transform them into bloodthirsty zombies. Horror remake, starring Jane Levy and Shiloh Fernandez.

programme.title: The Crow
programme.desc: Eric and Shelly meet in rehabilitation and fall in love. When a ruthless criminal has them murdered, Eric is resurrected and granted supernatural powers. Guided by a mysterious spirit, he hunts those responsible through an underworld, hoping his vengeance will give him one chance to save Shelly's soul from damnation. Dark fantasy based on James O'Barr's cult comic book, starring Bill Skarsgård, FKA twigs, Danny Huston and Josette Simon.

programme.title: Him
programme.desc: Cameron Cade is predicted to be the next great quarterback of American football. During a night-time training session, he suffers a traumatic brain injury. Cameron agrees to attend a week-long boot camp run by retiring star quarterback Isaiah White at his secluded desert compound. However, Cade's life soon turns into a nightmare. Supernatural horror, starring Marlon Wayans and Tyriq Withers.

programme.title: Ick
programme.desc: A science teacher's life changes when he reconnects with his first love and suspects a new student is his daughter, all while facing an alien threat in their town. Sci-fi comedy drama, starring Brandon Routh, Mena Suvari and Malina Pauli Weissman.

programme.title: The Accursed
programme.desc: A woman named Elly is asked by family friend Alma to look after an elderly lady living in a remote cabin for a few days. She agrees, but soon discovers there is a demon hiding in the woman, waiting to break free. Horror, starring Mena Suvari, Sarah Grey and Meg Foster.

programme.title: I Don't Understand You
programme.desc: Stranded in rural Italy, an American couple on the verge of adopting tries to reconnect during a disastrous vacation. Comedic horror, starring Nick Kroll, Andrew Rannells and Amanda Seyfried.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: A dull American town in the middle of the desert is suddenly attacked by huge man-eating subterranean creatures. Luckily, two dim-witted but brave handymen step into the breach to lead a ragtag bunch of locals and a mismatched pair of survivalists in the battle against the gruesome worm-like monsters. Comedy horror, with Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter, Michael Gross, Reba McEntire and Bobby Jacoby.

programme.title: Night Patrol
programme.desc: An LA cop discovers a local task force is hiding a secret that puts the residents of his childhood neighbourhood in danger. Director Ryan Prows' horror thriller, starring Jermaine Fowler and Justin Long.

programme.desc: A family become convinced they are not alone after moving into their new home in the suburbs. Steven Soderbergh's horror thriller, starring Lucy Liu, Chris Sullivan, Callina Liang and Eddy Maday.

programme.title: M3GAN 2.0
programme.desc: Two years have passed since the robot M3GAN went rogue and almost killed her creator, engineer Gemma Forrester. Initially, Matt plans on selling the ranch, but then decides to keep it, hoping to impress his ex-lover, Janet (Terry Moore). The ranch, however, turns out to be in foreclosure, forcing Matt and Chip to come up with a plan to pay off their debt to the bank.

Enraged, and armed only with a speargun, George goes looking for justice.

programme.title: Woman on the Run
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, Frank Johnson goes on the run to avoid being killed himself. His wife, Eleanor (Ann Sheridan), seems almost apathetic about finding him when questioned by Investigator Harris (Robert Keith), due to a marriage on the rocks. However, after learning that Frank has a grave heart condition, Eleanor recruits reporter Dan Leggett (Dennis O'Keefe) to help track down Frank. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

programme.desc: San Francisco businessman Harry Graham (Edmond O'Brien) and his wife and business partner, Eve (Joan Fontaine), are in the process of adopting a child. When private investigator Jordan (Edmund Gwenn) uncovers the fact that Graham has another wife, Phyllis (Ida Lupino), and a small child in Los Angeles, he confesses everything. In flashback, Graham tells of the strains in his marriage with Eve and how he found himself falling for the kind-hearted waitress Phyllis while on a business trip.

programme.title: Woman on the Run
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, Frank Johnson goes on the run to avoid being killed himself. However, after learning that Frank has a grave heart condition, Eleanor recruits reporter Dan Leggett (Dennis O'Keefe) to help track down Frank. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

programme.desc: San Francisco businessman Harry Graham (Edmond O'Brien) and his wife and business partner, Eve (Joan Fontaine), are in the process of adopting a child. programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: Family Feud
programme.desc: In this original version of iconic game show "Family Feud," actor Richard Dawson plays host to two teams, each comprised of five family members, who try to match the answers given to survey questions asked to groups of people (typically 100 people in the group). programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Super Password
programme.desc: Like the 1960s version, two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

The family pursues forgotten dreams and challenges as their strength is tested against personal struggles.

programme.title: Sue Thomas F.B.Eye
programme.desc: This light-hearted police drama follows a sheltered deaf woman who is about to start her first real job with the FBI. When she is given the tedious task of analyzing fingerprints, Sue is disappointed but doesn't remain there for long. An FBI agent discovers her ability to read lips and promotes Sue to an elite surveillance team. Suddenly, Sue and her hearing dog, Levi, are "G-Men," involved in a lot more action than they bargained for. This series is loosely based on the real-life deaf FBI agent Sue Thomas.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: The Players Club
programme.desc: Single mother Diana Armstrong takes to sliding down a stripper pole in order to pay for college -- and make a better life for her child. But taking off her clothes for a paying audience is the easy part at the Player's Club. More challenging for Diana is staying on the good side of motor-mouthed club owner Dolla Bill, avoiding the club's unsavory cast of characters and helping her newbie stripping cousin, Ebony, stay on the straight and narrow.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk: Straight, No Chaser
programme.desc: Along with Charlie Parker and Dizzy Gillespie, pianist Thelonious Monk is credited as one of the pioneering musicians of bebop and is the second most recorded jazz composer in the world. Charlotte Zwerin's documentary tries to unravel Monk, who was known for having a thorny personality and an aggressive playing technique to match. Interviews with Monk's son and fellow musicians shed some light, and performance footage from a European tour captures his idiosyncratic style.

programme.title: Who's the Man?
programme.desc: Ed Lover (Ed Lover) and Doctor Dre (Andre Romelle Young) are hapless New York City barbers who test the patience of their boss, Nick Crawford (Jim Moody), one too many times and end up at a police academy to try out careers in law enforcement. Training under the tough-as-nails Sergeant Cooper (Denis Leary), Ed and Dre eventually learn enough skills to become rookie cops. For their first major assignment, they attempt to thwart a corrupt businessman at odds with Nick over property development.

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Too Little
programme.desc: In London to celebrate his birthday with James (Peter Gallagher), his rich younger brother, hapless American Wallace Ritchie (Bill Murray) gets signed up to participate in an elaborate role-playing theater performance. However, when Wallace accidentally receives a call intended for an actual hit man, he gets caught in a web of intrigue, completely unaware that the action unfolding around him is real. Luckily, the lovely Lori (Joanne Whalley) is around to help the clueless guy out of tight spots.

programme.title: Mr. & Mrs. Smith
programme.desc: John and Jane Smith, a couple in a stagnating marriage, live a deceptively mundane existence. However, each has been hiding a secret from the other: they are assassins working for adversarial agencies. When they are both assigned to kill the same target, Benjamin Danz, the truth comes to the surface. Finally free from their cover stories, they discover that they have been assigned to kill each other, sparking a series of explosive attacks.

programme.desc: Many popular court shows are on TV. How can the genre improve? How about using a three-judge panel? That's the concept of "Hot Bench," created by Judge Judy Sheindlin. After hearing each case, the judges discuss it among themselves before rendering a verdict. The jurists are experienced civil litigator Tanya Acker, New York State Supreme Court Justice Patricia DiMango, and former criminal defense attorney Larry Bakman. The show's title comes from a term describing a court action in which a judge frequently interrupts lawyers with questions.

programme.desc: With assistance from partner Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), Texas Ranger Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) helps rancher Jenny Morgan (Jennifer Holt) recover her stolen herd. For Eddie, the theft comes as a shock, as it may have been perpetrated by his twin, who is known as "the Tioga Kid" (also Dean). Suddenly, the brothers are at odds as never before. Things get even dicier when wanted posters depict a man who looks exactly like Eddie, causing some to believe that he's actually the bad guy.

programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: Jerry Mason (John Wayne), fresh out of college back East, heads home to Texas to join a blacksmith business with family friend Jake (George Hayes). But when they discover a gold nugget in a horseshoe, they're led down a dangerous path, as crooks Joe Cole (Yakima Canutt) and Harris (Lloyd Whitlock) scheme to take the rock from the unsuspecting Jerry and Jake. This ultimately gets Jake shot and wounded, lands Jerry in jail unjustly and leaves the pair plotting to get revenge on the criminals.

programme.title: Check Your Guns
programme.desc: Gunslinger Eddie (Eddie Dean) rides into the Wild West town of Red Gap, Colo., which is run by land-hungry saloon owner Brad Taggert (Stan Jolley) and corrupt circuit judge Hammond (Bill Fawcett). When the sheriff is killed by members of Taggert's gang, Eddie is appointed to take his place. Along with his deputy, barbershop owner Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), and ranch owner Cathy Jordan (Nancy Gates), Eddie takes aim at Taggert and his gang, led by sharpshooter Ace Bannion (Mikel Conrad).

programme.title: Oath of Vengeance
programme.desc: Cowhands Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) open a general store together in a town embroiled in a battle between ranchers and farmers. Cattleman Dale Kirby (Mady Lawrence) believes the farmers have been stealing cattle, forcing him to borrow from crooked lender Steve Kinney (Jack Ingram). In truth, however, it is Kinney himself who is behind the cattle thefts. When Billy attempts to mediate, he and Fuzzy find themselves threatened by Kinney.

programme.title: Cheyenne Takes Over
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Cheyenne (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his sidekick, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are en route to a much-needed vacation at Fuzzy's friend's ranch. But, upon arriving, the partners find that Fuzzy's pal has been killed, and a fishy group of characters has taken over the ranch, claiming to have inherited it from the dead man. Immediately suspicious, the lawmen team up with local saloon owner Fay Wilkins (Nancy Gates), and forgo their vacation in favor of a murder investigation.

programme.title: Overland Riders
programme.desc: Cowboy Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) is riding in a stagecoach with young Jean (Patti McCarty), on his way to a business deal with her father. The coach is attacked by bandits, but luckily Fuzzy's buddy Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) is in the vicinity, and he comes to the rescue, fending off the outlaws. Billy helps Jean get back home, only to learn that the bandits he's just thwarted have killed her father and pinned the crime on Fuzzy. Billy then must go after the real murderers.

programme.title: Rimfire
programme.desc: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost.

programme.title: Prairie Rustlers
programme.desc: In a small town, the sheriff is murdered, and Deputy Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), a diner owner by day, must take over the slain lawman's responsibilities. The leader of the cattle rustlers who killed the sheriff is named Jim (Buster Crabbe), and he bears a striking resemblance to Fuzzy's friend Billy (Buster Crabbe), much to the deputy's confusion. Billy comes to town, and, to help Fuzzy and vanquish the rustlers, he must face Jim, his cousin, who still holds a grudge against him.

programme.title: In Old Amarillo
programme.desc: A villainous cannery owner tries to foil efforts to get water to cattle ranchers during a severe drought.

programme.title: Wild Country
programme.desc: Bandit Rip Caxton (I. Stanford Jolley) escapes from prison, and U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) track him to a small town. There, Caxton kills a sheriff, and, with the help of crooked local saloon boss Clark Varney (Douglas Fowley), installs a conspirator in the dead lawman's place. Meanwhile, Eddie comes across Martha Devery (Peggy Wynn), the distressed daughter of the former sheriff, and promises her he will bring the villains to justice.

programme.title: Shotgun

programme.title: Iron Eagle on the Attack
programme.desc: Retired from the Air Force, Chappy Sinclair (Lou Gossett Jr.) now runs a private flight school that happens to cater to misfits and juvenile offenders. programme.title: Lockup: Indiana: Extended Stay
programme.desc: A brutal stabbing puts Indiana State Prison on edge; a brash new inmate gets taken down a notch; two buddies do their time together; cameras are put into the hands of inmates who share intimate thoughts about life behind bars.

programme.title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
programme.desc: A female inmate finds romance with an alleged gang leader and the jailhouse prepares for a wedding; a very powerful inmate must make a choice between his crime family and his real family.

programme.title: Lockup
programme.desc: Angola Penitentiary in Louisiana.

programme.title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay
programme.desc: For some inmates, the only way out of prison is "paroling legit," or leaving in a body bag; others earn a lump sum of good time by completing programs or holding a prison job, while a few will take any chance to try to escape.

programme.title: Lockup: Raw
programme.desc: Jail stays are getting longer and many inmates have very little, leading to violence erupting over any perceived slight, especially if it involves food.

programme.title: Lockup: Tampa: Extended Stay
programme.desc: An inmate with a long record runs an extortion scheme, while drugs inside the jail pose a lethal threat; the jail's newest team member makes her presence known.

programme.title: Lockup: Oakland: Extended Stay
programme.desc: Deputies respond to rising tensions in a female housing unit; a popular rapper, whose ups and downs have been told in the Oakland media, now faces serious charges; a grandmother convicted of a mortgage scam finds her place in the inmate hierarchy.

programme.title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
programme.desc: When Travis Trani took charge in 2008 he oversaw the implementation of several new policies; the restrictions on movement were among the toughest; inmates from the six different housing units could no longer freely move throughout the prison.

programme.title: Lockup: Cleveland: Extended Stay
programme.desc: The tenth floor of Cuyahoga County Correction Center contains the Special Response Team, or SERT, a tactical unit trained in the use of riot gear, non-lethal weapons and controlling high-risk inmates.

programme.title: Lockup: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay
programme.desc: An inmate takes drastic action and leaves his cell in a bloody mess; dangerous contraband is found on another inmate at Florida's Santa Rosa Correctional Institution.

programme.title: Lockup: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay
programme.desc: A massive search for contraband throughout the facility turns up the heat on two inmates inside the Santa Rosa Correctional Institution; a convict prompts an evacuation when he floods his housing unit.

programme.title: Lockup: Orange County: Extended Stay
programme.desc: Every year, close to 70,000 people are processed through the five facilities that make up the Orange County Jail in Southern California; some will call the jail home until their cases are resolved in court - a process that can take years.

programme.title: Lockup: Fairfax: Extended Stay
programme.desc: A gang member with a violent past and a long disciplinary record in jail tries to convince staff he's changed; another inmate, once a victim of prison rape, lobbies to do his time in isolation.

programme.title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
programme.desc: Wabash Valley Correctional Facility houses some of the highest security prisoners in the state; corrections staff investigate a potential escape plot and one inmate with a very familiar face tells their own story.

programme.title: Lockup: Savannah: Extended Stay
programme.desc: A jail program attempts to save shelter dogs from being put down; an Army veteran must face his own demons; pregnant and charged with murder, one inmate must decide whether to turn in a family member to save herself.

programme.title: Miracles In Motion
programme.desc: Join Greg and Jill Morikone on Miracles in Motion for an uplifting episode titled Don’t Give Up!, featuring Laura Sommerfield's powerful journey to faith. Raised Methodist and later becoming Catholic, Laura’ s life took a turn in 2016 when she stumbled upon 3ABN while recovering from surgery. Intrigued by the preaching of Lonnie Melashenko, she began to explore the truths of the Bible and found herself questioning her beliefs, especially after losing her mother. After receiving heartfelt guidance from Pastor Lonnie, Laura made the decision to surrender her life to Jesus. Despite resistance from friends and family, she was baptized in the Seventh-day Adventist Church by Pastor Lonnie, with Greg and Jill present to witness her transformation. Tune in to hear how 3ABN helped Laura find peace, purpose, and a deeper relationship with Christ.

programme.title: Truth for Life
programme.desc: In Dealing With Temptation & Addiction, Dr. Mark Sandoval presents a biblical framework for understanding why temptation leads to addiction and how true freedom is restored. Grounded in the law of God and the principle of source, this episode explains how temptation always begins by drawing the heart away from God as the only reliable source of life and love. Addiction is revealed not as a moral failure, but as a misguided attempt to meet legitimate needs through false substitutes. Dr. Sandoval carefully outlines the addiction cycle, showing how unmet needs, temporary relief, guilt, fear, and secrecy reinforce bondage. He emphasizes that behavioral control alone cannot heal addiction; only a transformed heart, satisfied by God’s love, can bring lasting freedom. This presentation also offers compassionate guidance for loved ones, highlighting the importance of hope, truth, and non-rescuing support. Viewers are invited to see temptation as a signal to return to God rather than flee from Him.

programme.title: Truth for Life
programme.desc: In Dealing With Temptation & Addiction, Dr. Mark Sandoval presents a biblical framework for understanding why temptation leads to addiction and how true freedom is restored. Grounded in the law of God and the principle of source, this episode explains how temptation always begins by drawing the heart away from God as the only reliable source of life and love. Addiction is revealed not as a moral failure, but as a misguided attempt to meet legitimate needs through false substitutes. Dr. Sandoval carefully outlines the addiction cycle, showing how unmet needs, temporary relief, guilt, fear, and secrecy reinforce bondage. He emphasizes that behavioral control alone cannot heal addiction; only a transformed heart, satisfied by God’s love, can bring lasting freedom. This presentation also offers compassionate guidance for loved ones, highlighting the importance of hope, truth, and non-rescuing support. Viewers are invited to see temptation as a signal to return to God rather than flee from Him.

programme.title: Multitude of Counselors
programme.desc: Presenting Problem: Tamika, a 29 year-old upper middle-class mother of Jamaican heritage, with two small children, presents with severe depression over the last several months. She feels overwhelmed by her responsibilities and can’t seem to function as a stay-at-home mom. Her husband, a 30 year-old second-generation Romanian immigrant and mechanical engineer working for General Motors, provides well for the family, but feels bewildered by his wife’s difficulties, given their beautiful home and healthy children. She reports that he has insisted that she get help for her depression, and this is why she is here.

programme.title: The Ultimate Encounter
programme.desc: Through powerful scriptures and profound reflections, we uncover how Jesus intervened when we were helpless, offering us undeserved love and victory. Learn how Christ is our source of growth, how He empowers us to overcome impossibilities, and how we can recognize and resist the true enemy. Today, discover the power of change that comes from staying connected to Jesus and learn how to live in the victory He has already won for us.

programme.desc: In this episode, Noah travels to the Southwest to explore Yosemite National Park and Zion National Park. programme.title: Awesome Science
programme.desc: In this episode, Noah travels to one of the few active volcanoes in the contiguous United States to find out why it’s called, “God’s gift to creationists.” Through cataclysmic events back in the 1980s, similar geologic features worldwide can now be explained by the Flood using Mount St. Helens as a scale model. Noah explores each of these features at the mountain, including a huge lava cave and lava cast forests. The features found here can help us understand catastrophic processes that were thought by secular scientists to take millions of years taking only hours or days.

programme.title: 3ABN Hoy
programme.sub-title: Testimonio personal del Pr. José Feliciano Castillo Lugo
programme.desc: En esta inspiradora entrevista, el Pastor José Feliciano Castillo Lugo comparte profundamente su testimonio personal. Inicia relatando su infancia en Castaños, Coahuila (México), marcada por el alcoholismo de su padre. Sin embargo, tras “un último trago”, su padre decidió darle una oportunidad a Cristo. Este paso lo llevó a la Iglesia Adventista del Séptimo Día local, donde se bautizó y experimentó una transformación total, convirtiéndose en un ejemplo de rectitud para su familia. El Pr. Castillo continúa narrando su etapa como universitario, un periodo lleno de adversidades, frustraciones y desafíos. A pesar de ello, afirma que Dios lo sostuvo y lo ayudó a superar cada obstáculo. En ese proceso, Dios le mostró los “caminos torcidos” en los que viví a, y él tomó la decisión de enderezar sus pasos para honrar a Dios. Esta experiencia de cambio lo llevó finalmente al ministerio. Después de servir como oficial en México, hoy es evangelista y pastor en el estado de Tennessee, donde continúa compartiendo el mensaje de esperanza. Está casado con KeSardis, quien lo acompaña en el ministerio, y juntos crían a sus tres hijas. La entrevista es un testimonio poderoso de cómo Dios transforma vidas y abre nuevos comienzos. Para más historias de transformación y una amplia programación cristiana, puede descargar gratuitamente la aplicación 3ABN+ y suscribirse al canal 3ABN Latino en YouTube.

programme.desc: Philippe Cousteau Jr. is no stranger to exploration. The grandson of legendary underwater explorer Jacques Cousteau, Philippe hosts and serves as executive producer of this half-hour earth science series that examines the planet. He visits diamond and gold mines to see how gems and metals are formed, travels to active volcanoes to observe what happens inside the Earth's burning core, and checks out weather stations in mountainous areas to get an idea of how weather phenomena form in the atmosphere.

programme.desc: Americans have been fascinated by the cosmos for decades and rely on NASA to explore celestial bodies seen in the night sky to get a better idea of what is out there. In this series, former NASA employee Emily Calandrelli visits some of the agency's facilities, private companies and universities to speak with people knowledgeable about the topic to help "show off the coolest aspects of the space industry," to use her words. Technology, a potential manned mission to Mars and planetary tourism are some themes.

programme.title: Nature Knows Best
programme.desc: Marine biologist Danni Washington hosts this series that explains how nature has helped to inspire technology that people use on a daily basis. Some of the nature-inspired innovations include airplanes inspired by birds and helicopters that were influenced by dragonflies. The show also introduces viewers to people involved in creating innovations that are based on animals, including biologists who study the behavior of ants, architects designing "living buildings" and roboticists who are making their designs bigger and stronger based on animals.

programme.title: Small Town Big Deal
programme.desc: To put a spin on a popular saying about Las Vegas, what happens in a small town stays in a small town. That's because small cities and towns across America often get lost in the mainstream media that focuses on major metropolitan areas like New York and Los Angeles. "Small Town Big Deal" tries to change that by telling the stories of innovation, tradition and success that are happening in rural places. Episodes cover small-town residents having an impact on others through their actions and notable businesses, including the Frankenmuth, Mich., retail store that is considered the world's largest Christmas store.

programme.title: Street Magic
programme.desc: Troy Von Scheibner first became interested in magic at the age of 12, practiced the art through various odd jobs throughout childhood and college, and now is one of the most popular magicians in England. This reality series shows what happens when the performer hits the streets of London to showcase his close-up magic and stunts for unsuspecting locals and tourists. Von Scheibner takes advantage of his surroundings by drawing inspiration from the city's landmarks while integrating them into some of his illusions, such as teleporting across Tower Bridge. Some of Troy's tricks are more restrained, though, like when he uses his talents to help passengers get off of a bus.

programme.desc: A charming but troubled country singer learns he has a 5-year-old son that he didn't know existed. Struggling with alcohol addiction, he must now decide whether to raise the boy or leave his family behind to pursue his dream of musical stardom.

programme.title: The Stepfather
programme.desc: A young man (Penn Badgley) becomes increasingly suspicious that his mother's new lover (Dylan Walsh) is concealing an evil side.","large":"When Michael Harding (Penn Badgley) returns home from military school, he discovers that his mother (Sela Ward) has a new man, named David (Dylan Walsh), in her life. Though David makes Michael's mother very happy, Michael cannot seem to shake feelings of distrust. He becomes increasingly suspicious of the man and wonders if the pleasant exterior hides a sinister side.

programme.title: Darkness Falls
programme.desc: The spirit of a woman who was lynched more than 150 years earlier haunts residents (Emma Caulfield, Lee Cormie) of a New England town.","large":"In Maine, the residents of Darkness Falls are all aware of the legend of Matilda Dixon, an old woman who was tragically murdered by a mob in the 1800s because the townspeople thought she was killing children. Now Darkness Falls has to contend with Matilda's supernatural wrath. Childhood friends Kyle (Chaney Kley) and Caitlin (Emma Caulfield) return home to uncover the truth behind the legend after Caitlin's little brother (Lee Cormie) has recurring nightmares about Matilda.

programme.title: Red Water
programme.desc: A shark terrorizes a divorced couple (Lou Diamond Phillips, Kristy Swanson) and three boat hijackers on a Louisiana river.","large":"Former oil rig worker John Sanders (Lou Diamond Phillips) became a Louisiana fishing captain after a tragic accident ended his career. In need of money, he agrees to help his ex-wife, Kelli (Kristy Swanson), whose company is having trouble extracting oil upriver. Meanwhile, thugs working for a Jamaican gangster head to the same bayou searching for $3 million buried underwater. Both the scientists and the criminals are menaced by a man-eating shark that can survive in fresh water.

programme.title: Bermuda Triangle
programme.desc: A physician's (Sam Behrens) family is stranded on an island community of survivors presumed lost in the infamous Bermuda Triangle.

programme.title: Wild America
programme.desc: Three Arkansas brothers (Jonathan Taylor Thomas, Devon Sawa, Scott Bairstow) travel across the country filming animals in their habitats during the summer of 1967.","large":"The fearless young Stouffer brothers -- Marty (Scott Bairstow), Mark (Devon Sawa) and Marshall (Jonathan Taylor Thomas) -- can hardly imagine going into the family business hawking auto parts in small-town Arkansas. With the begrudging approval of their no-nonsense father, the brothers set out on a dangerous cross-country camping trip, intending to capture on film their encounters with wild animals and the last remnants of the natural world in the rapidly vanishing American West.

programme.title: The Last Dragonslayer
programme.desc: A young orphan girl (Ellise Chappell), indentured servant to a magician, discovers that she's destined to become the last dragonslayer in a world with only one remaining dragon.

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: Bullied teen (Ralph Macchio) learns karate from handyman Mr. Miyagi (Noriyuki "Pat" Morita).

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part II
programme.desc: Mr. Miyagi returns to Okinawa with his karate student and meets an old foe's challenge to a duel.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part III
programme.desc: Mr. Miyagi and his student open a bonsai-tree shop, then fight thugs sent by a millionaire toxic-waste dumper.","large":"Cobra Kai karate instructor John Kreese (Martin Kove) is still brooding over the defeat handed to him by Daniel LaRusso (Ralph Macchio) and Mr. Miyagi (Noriyuki "Pat" Morita). With his slimy partner, Terry Silver (Thomas Ian Griffith), Kreese plans an intricate payback that involves hiring a mean-spirited ringer (Sean Kanan) to rob Daniel of his championship title. When Mr. Miyagi refuses to train Daniel, even under threat, the boy makes the mistake of turning to Terry for guidance.

programme.title: The Next Karate Kid
programme.desc: Mr. Miyagi (Noriyuki "Pat" Morita) teaches angry 17-year-old girl (Hilary Swank).

programme.title: Fun With Dick and Jane
programme.desc: After losing their jobs, an affluent couple (Jim Carrey, Téa Leoni) turn to robbery to support their lifestyle.","large":"After Dick Harper (Jim Carrey) loses his job at Globodyne in an Enron-esque collapse, he and his wife, Jane (Téa Leoni), turn to crime in order to handle the massive debt they now face. Two intelligent people, Dick and Jane actually get pretty good at robbing people and even enjoy it -- but they have second thoughts when they're reminded that crime can hurt innocent people. When the couple hears that Globodyne boss Jack McCallister (Alec Baldwin) actually swindled the company, they plot revenge.

programme.title: The Interview
programme.desc: When a tabloid-TV host (James Franco) and producer (Seth Rogen) land an interview with Kim Jong-un, the CIA recruits the pair to assassinate the North Korean dictator instead.","large":"Dave Skylark (James Franco) and his producer Aaron Rapaport (Seth Rogen) are the team behind the popular tabloid-TV show "Skylark Tonight." After learning that North Korea's Kim Jong-un (Randall Park) is a huge fan of the show, they successfully set up an interview with him, hoping to legitimize themselves as actual journalists. However, as Dave and Aaron prepare for their journey to Pyongyang, the CIA steps in, recruits them, and assigns them an incredible mission: Assassinate the dictator.

programme.title: Did You Hear About the Morgans?
programme.desc: A husband (Hugh Grant) and wife (Sarah Jessica Parker) get a chance to repair their crumbling marriage when, after they witness a murder, federal agents hide them in a tiny Wyoming town.","large":"New Yorkers Paul (Hugh Grant) and Meryl (Sarah Jessica Parker) Morgan seem to have it all -- except that their marriage is crumbling around them. But their romantic woes are small compared to the trouble they find themselves in after witnessing a murder. To protect them from an assassin, federal agents whisk away Paul and Meryl to a small town in Wyoming, where their marriage will crash and burn, or their passion will reignite.

programme.title: Life Without Dick
programme.desc: After consulting a fortuneteller, painter Colleen (Sarah Jessica Parker) begins to suspect that her private-eye boyfriend, Dick (Johnny Knoxville), is cheating and accidentally kills him.","large":"After consulting a fortuneteller, painter Colleen (Sarah Jessica Parker) begins to suspect that her private-eye boyfriend, Dick (Johnny Knoxville), is cheating. When she comes home and finds him packing to leave her, Colleen accidentally kills him. Nervous Irish Mafia hit man Daniel (Harry Connick Jr.), who's been gunning for Dick, arrives shortly afterward and admits he has never successfully completed a job. Daniel proposes to take credit for the murder, and the odd couple fall in love.

programme.title: I Dreamed of Africa
programme.desc: After a harrowing car accident, a woman (Kim Basinger) and her family (Vincent Perez, Liam Aiken) move to Africa where she eventually becomes a celebrated conservationist.","large":"Inspired by the true story of indomitable Kuki Gallmann, the film tells of a beautiful and inquisitive woman who had the courage to escape from her comfortable yet monotonous life in Italy to start anew in the African wilderness with her son, Emanuele, and her new husband, Paolo. Gallmann faces great danger there but eventually becomes a celebrated conservationist.

programme.title: Places in the Heart
programme.desc: A widowed mother fights for her cotton farm in the 1930s Texas.

programme.title: Murphy's Romance
programme.desc: A divorced mother (Sally Field) moves to an Arizona ranch and meets a widowed pharmacist (James Garner) twice her age.","large":"Emma (Sally Field), a divorced single mother seeking to start her life over, moves to a small town in Arizona. She builds a relationship with Murphy (James Garner), the older local pharmacist but, due to his age, it remains platonic. Their friendship becomes complicated when Emma's ex-husband, Bobby Jack (Brian Kerwin), shows up. He claims to have changed his ways, but when he turns out to be the same man Emma divorced, she discovers her true feelings for Murphy.

programme.title: America's Sweethearts
programme.desc: A publicist (Billy Crystal) tries to convince the press that the feuding co-stars of a new movie are still in love.","large":"For an awkward, self-conscious girl like Kiki (Julia Roberts), being the personal assistant to a beautiful megastar like Gwen (Catherine Zeta-Jones) isn't easy. But when she dutifully accepts the task of helping Gwen and her estranged husband Eddie (John Cusack) make it through one last public appearance masterminded by legendary press agent Lee Phillips (Billy Crystal), forever devoted Kiki finds that her job is about to get even harder when her and Eddie's relationship takes a romantic turn.

programme.title: Ice Castles
programme.desc: A figure skater searches for inner strength after a tragic accident jeopardizes her future.

programme.title: Crossroads
programme.desc: A guitar student (Ralph Macchio) tours the Deep South with an old blues man (Joe Seneca), chasing a lost song written by Robert Johnson.

programme.title: Lost & Found
programme.desc: To rebuild their family fortune, teenage brothers hunt for treasure while spending the summer on a remote island.","large":"Sent to spend the summer with their uncle on a remote island, young brothers, Andy (Justin Kelly) and Mark (Benjamin Stockham), learn that their eccentric grandfather once owned the island but vanished without a trace, taking with him the secret to a vast fortune. Delving into the mysterious past of the island, the brothers discover that their grandfather designed a complex treasure hunt, a hunt that could lead to unimaginable wealth and heal their broken family.

programme.title: First Daughter
programme.desc: A female Secret Service agent (Mariel Hemingway) and a river guide (Doug Savant) must rescue the president's kidnapped daughter (Monica Keena).

programme.title: First Target
programme.desc: A Secret Service agent trains long and hard to protect the president, only to realize too late that the opening of new mountain transport in Seattle is just a ploy to ambush him.

programme.title: First Shot
programme.desc: A military rebel group resurfaces with a vengeance to assassinate the president for the death of their brothers. Agent McGregor, the head of the Secret Service, tries to prevent attacks on the president's life.

programme.title: The Lazarus Project
programme.desc: A death-row inmate (Paul Walker) searches for the truth after he mysteriously awakes in a psychiatric hospital.

programme.title: Conspiracy
programme.desc: A former Marine (Val Kilmer) brings justice to a small town after his friend mysteriously disappears.

programme.title: Straw Dogs
programme.desc: A screenwriter (James Marsden) and his wife (Kate Bosworth) are pushed into a violent confrontation with locals after they move to the woman's Mississippi hometown for the summer.","large":"Married couple David (James Marsden) and Amy (Kate Bosworth) move to her hometown of Blackwater, Miss., after her father's death. They have a plan to renovate Amy's old home and prepare it for sale while David works on his latest screenplay. However, the sophisticated couple's arrival stirs resentment and suspicion among the locals, especially from Charlie (Alexander Skarsgård), Amy's former boyfriend. Tension continues to build, leading to an extremely violent confrontation.

programme.title: The Stepfather

programme.title: The Ambushers
programme.desc: A secret agent (Dean Martin) saves a flying-saucer prototype and its pilot (Janice Rule) in the third of four Matt Helm movies.

programme.title: Shockproof
programme.desc: Jenny Marsh is a hard-luck dame who's just finished five years in the slammer for killing a man. Jenny's not exactly the murdering type -- she did the deed while defending her jailbird lover, Harry, which is probably one reason she's attracted the attention of her parole officer, Griff Marat. In fact, Griff is so taken with Jenny that he gets her a job caring for his ailing mother, but although Jenny tries to fly right, she's not yet over Harry.

programme.title: 5 Against the House
programme.desc: When college buddies Ronnie (Kerwin Mathews) and Roy (Alvy Moore) are briefly detained by the Reno police in association with a casino robbery, Ronnie becomes obsessed with figuring out how to plan the perfect heist. At first, it is a strictly intellectual exercise, but when the emotionally disturbed Korean War vet Brick (Brian Keith) gets involved, the friends -- including straitlaced Al (Guy Madison) and his nightclub-singer girlfriend, Kaye (Kim Novak) -- have to pull the job for real.

programme.title: The Chase
programme.desc: When "Bubber" Reeves (Robert Redford) escapes from prison, it upsets the folks in the nearby town of Tarl, Texas. Sheriff Calder (Marlon Brando) wants to capture Reeves alive, which puts him in opposition to many of the townspeople who have resorted to mob justice. Businessman Val Rogers (E.G. Marshall) wants Calder to apprehend Reeves quickly, through any means, since he fears the criminal will come after Val's son, Jake, who is sleeping with Reeves' wife (Jane Fonda).

programme.title: A Night to Remember
programme.desc: In this suspenseful comedy, Nancy Troy (Loretta Young) and her mystery-author husband, Jeff (Brian Aherne), move into a dark basement apartment in New York City's Greenwich Village, in hopes of stirring up writing inspiration. When their neighbors begin acting oddly and one of them turns up dead, Nancy and Jeff must uncover a murder mystery in their own building, with a number of suspects lurking about, including the creepy Mrs. Devoe (Gale Sondergaard).

programme.title: It Happened to Jane
programme.desc: After a shipment of fresh lobsters isn't delivered on time to Jane Osgood (Doris Day), a widowed mother of two running a failing restaurant supply business in Maine, she hires her lawyer friend George Denham (Jack Lemmon) to sue the railroad company she believes is responsible for the damages. The court case generates lots of publicity and Osgood is famous. A charismatic news reporter (Steve Forrest) takes to Osgood, but that doesn't sit well with Denham, who also has eyes for her.

programme.title: Her Husband's Affairs
programme.desc: Advertising executive William Weldon (Franchot Tone) narrowly averts career implosion when his clever wife, Margaret (Lucille Ball), helps him save an important advertising account. But tensions run high in the Weldon household after William's fast-talking employer, J.B. Cruikshank (Edward Everett Horton), invites Margaret to work for him too. The cunning couple must compete with each other to write a campaign for Emil Glinka (Mikhail Rasumny) -- a mad scientist with an alarming new product.

programme.title: Walk, Don't Run
programme.desc: Arriving in Tokyo two days before the Olympic Games, Sir William Rutland (Cary Grant) struggles to find accommodations due to the number of tourists. When Rutland responds to a roommate-wanted ad posted at the British Embassy, he meets Christine Easton (Samantha Eggar), who reluctantly allows him to move in. Soon, Rutland decides to offer half of his room to an American athlete, Steve Davis (Jim Hutton) -- and when he notices Easton and Davis hitting it off, he tries to bring them together.

programme.title: From Here to Eternity
programme.desc: At an Army barracks in Hawaii in the days preceding the attack on Pearl Harbor, lone-wolf soldier and boxing champion Prew Prewitt (Montgomery Clift) refuses to box, preferring to play the bugle instead. Hard-hearted Capt. Holmes (Philip Ober) subjects Prew to a grueling series of punishments while, unknown to Holmes, the gruff but fair Sgt. Warden (Burt Lancaster) engages in a clandestine affair with the captain's mistreated wife (Deborah Kerr).

programme.title: Three on a Couch
programme.desc: Christopher Pride (Jerry Lewis) has been offered an important commission in Paris but can't convince his girlfriend, Dr. Elizabeth Acord (Janet Leigh), to take some time off from her psychiatric practice. Elizabeth is worried about three of her female patients, all of whom are extremely hostile toward men and very needy. Christopher, anxious to leave for France, decides to impersonate the ideal man for each of Elizabeth's patients, in hopes of lessening their dependency on her.

programme.title: The Key
programme.desc: During World War II, Englishwoman Stella (Sophia Loren) is involved with Capt. Ford (Trevor Howard), who commands a military tugboat. Ford's mission is dangerous because his slow-moving ship is an easy target. Eventually, he is gunned down in action and Capt. Ross (William Holden) replaces him. Before long, Ross also begins a relationship with Stella, but she warns the newcomer that she may be cursed -- captain after captain has come through her door, and each has met the same grim fate at sea.

programme.title: The Game That Kills
programme.desc: A man infiltrates a hockey team to investigate the death of his brother, the team's star left wing.

programme.title: Jason and the Argonauts
programme.desc: After saving the life of his royal father's usurper, Pelias (Douglas Wilmer), whom he fails to recognize, Jason (Todd Armstrong) is encouraged by the conniving murderer to begin a quest in search of the Golden Fleece. In doing so, Pelias hopes for Jason's death to thwart the prophecy that he will reclaim the throne. Along the journey, Jason is protected by the goddess Hera (Honor Blackman), and his crew includes Hercules (Nigel Green) and Acastus (Gary Raymond), a saboteur planted by Pelias.

programme.title: Theodora Goes Wild

programme.title: Cactus Flower

Impressed by her action, her lover, dentist Julian Winston (Walter Matthau) reconsiders marrying Toni, but he worries about her insistence on honesty. Having fabricated a wife and three children, Julian readily accepts when his devoted nurse, Stephanie (Ingrid Bergman), who has secretly loved Julian for years, offers to act as his wife and demand a divorce.

programme.title: To Sir, With Love
