While the students at first see Thackeray as just another teacher open for ridicule and bullying, his calm demeanor and desire to see them succeed gradually earn him their respect.

As a Norwegian team headed by Straud struggles to stop Nazi science in its tracks, a civilian hostage situation erupts.

programme.desc: Mal Granger (Edmond O'Brien) is a telephone repairman with a passion for horse betting. He puts his electronics expertise to work assisting gangster Vince Walters (Barry Kelly) in expanding his illegal racing wire, and, when Walters is murdered, Granger takes over the operation. However, Granger's growing success is soon threatened by both Larry Mason (Donald Porter), an East Coast mobster who wants in on the action, and Lieutenant Pete Wright (Howard St. John), who's after Granger for murder.

programme.title: Jeanne Eagels

With her heart set on filling a Broadway marquee with her name, Eagels takes acting lessons and earns a job as an understudy for a big production. But what she really wants is the starring role -- and she'll hurt anyone to get it.

programme.title: The Mouse That Roared
programme.desc: When the tiny nation of Grand Fenwick's only export, a special wine, begins to be produced in California, their entire economy collapses. Things look dire until Prime Minister Rupert Mountjoy (Peter Sellers) points out that no country that has declared war on the United States has ever gone hungry. When Field Marshall Tully Bascombe (Peter Sellers) and the 23 other men in the Grand Fenwick army invade the United States, their plan to immediately surrender unravels.

programme.title: Phffft!

Nina has a date with a suave actor (Donald Curtis), and Robert meets a blonde bombshell (Kim Novak). However, when their dalliances get complicated, they quickly realize that single life might not be what they bargained for.

programme.title: Gidget Grows Up
programme.desc: Gidget goes to New York, becomes a U.N. guide and meets an older man.

programme.title: Mickey One

When club owner Ed Castle (Hurd Hatfield) offers Mickey a shot at auditioning for an unknown man with reputed connections in the Midwest, the increasingly paranoid Mickey fears that the mob has finally closed in on him.

programme.title: Berserk
programme.desc: As the co-owner and ringmaster of a traveling circus, Monica Rivers (Joan Crawford) is always preoccupied with filling seats. But when several more performers meet gruesome deaths, it becomes apparent they are no accidents, and there's a killer on the loose.

programme.title: The Daring Young Man
programme.desc: After the military turns him down as being unfit, a man proves himself a hero by cracking a Nazi spy ring.

programme.title: Under the Yum Yum Tree
programme.desc: Libidinous Hogan (Jack Lemmon) is a landlord who prefers to rent his rooms to attractive single females. Hogan is instantly smitten with a pretty new tenant named Robin (Carol Lynley), but realizes that he'll have to contend with Robin's boyfriend, David (Dean Jones), if he's to attain the object of his desire. He gets his opportunity when he learns that the couple's living arrangement is a pre-marital experiment to see if they would be compatible as partners when sex is out of the equation.

programme.title: The Mating of Millie
programme.desc: A businesswoman (Evelyn Keyes) asks a bachelor (Glenn Ford) to help her find a husband so she can adopt an orphan.

programme.title: All Ashore
programme.desc: Sailors Joe (Dick Haymes) and Skip (Ray McDonald) habitually take advantage of their shipmate, Moby (Mickey Rooney), who's robbed after they take him to a shady bar. When they have no money to go to Catalina Island, Calif., Joe arranges their travel by volunteering the clueless Moby to work on the ship. Skip later meets a glamorous dancer (Peggy Ryan), while Joe woos a nightclub owner (Jody Lawrance). Moby decides to leave, but finds himself coming to the rescue of a beautiful heiress.

programme.title: The Lone Wolf and His Lady
programme.desc: When a gem disappears from an exhibition, jewel-thief-turned-reporter Lone Wolf (Ron Randell) is accused.

programme.title: Tell It to the Judge
programme.desc: Marsha Meredith (Rosalind Russell) has just been offered a position as a federal judge. Much to her dismay, her nomination is challenged on the grounds that her divorce renders her unsuitable for the courtroom. Desperate to win the position, Marsha arranges a fake marriage to Alexander (Gig Young), even though she still has feelings for Peter (Robert Cummings), her ex-husband. Marsha and Alexander -- and Marsha and Peter -- soon find themselves in a series of compromising situations.

programme.title: The Jolson Story
programme.desc: At the turn of the 20th century, young Asa Yoelson (Scotty Beckett) decides to go against the wishes of his cantor father (Ludwig Donath) and pursue a career in show business. Gradually working his way up through the vaudeville ranks, Asa -- now calling himself Al Jolson (Larry Parks) -- joins a blackface minstrel troupe and soon builds a reputation as a consummate performer. But as his career grows in size, so does his ego, resulting in battles in business as well as in his personal life.

programme.title: The Awful Truth
programme.desc: Jerry (Cary Grant) and Lucy (Irene Dunne) are a married couple who doubt each other's fidelity: Jerry suspects Lucy and her music teacher (Alexander D'Arcy) of spending an evening together, and Lucy is convinced Jerry lied about a business trip. When the jealous pair file for divorce, both rush into new relationships, but quickly realize their love never died. The soon-to-be-divorced husband and wife then both scramble to spoil each other's chances for newfound romance.

programme.desc: Princess Salome (Rita Hayworth) is the daughter of King Herod (Charles Laughton) of Galilee. Cast out after her affair with Caesar's nephew, Salome finds herself back in the kingdom of her father when she falls in love with Claudius (Stewart Granger), the commander of her father's army. Meanwhile, Salome's evil mother, Queen Herodias, is continually being condemned by John the Baptist, and plotting to use Salome as a tool to get the prophet executed.

programme.title: Forbidden
programme.desc: On a cruise ship headed to Havana, librarian Lulu Smith (Barbara Stanwyck) meets dashing attorney Bob Grover (Adolphe Menjou), and they quickly become inseparable. When they return home, their relationship is complicated by an inconvenient fact: Bob is married and unwilling to leave his bedridden wife. Their relationship dissolves, and Lulu decides not to tell him that she's pregnant with his child. But, when Bob becomes district attorney, a nosy reporter may uncover the explosive news anyway.

programme.title: Love Has Many Faces
programme.desc: Wealthy Kit Jordon (Lana Turner) and her dissolute husband, Pete (Cliff Robertson), are in Acapulco, Mexico, when a corpse washes onto the beach. The deceased was a lover of Kit's and a friend of Pete's, so the police question the Jordans. Then the dead man's girlfriend (Stefanie Powers) arrives, and she and Pete have an affair. Luckily, Kit has her choice of men to distract her. There is gigolo Hank (Hugh O'Brian), bullfighter Julian (Carlos Montalban) and, when in a pinch, even her husband.

programme.title: There's Something About a Soldier
programme.desc: Wally Williams (Tom Neal) and Frank Malloy (Bruce Bennett) are friends at an officers' school. Tension builds between them when they befriend Carol Harkness (Evelyn Keyes), a secretary at the school. While both men vie for Carol's affections, Wally alienates himself from the rest of the squad with his brashness. He has a change of heart when Carol tells him about Frank's heroic military service. He alters his behavior and wins Carol's heart in the process.

programme.title: The Running Man
programme.desc: When pilot Rex Black (Laurence Harvey) destroys his plane in a crash the day after his insurance policy expires, the insurance company refuses to give him any money. To strike back at the agency, Rex fakes his death, changes his identity and escapes to Spain, with 50,000 pounds in life insurance money. His wife (Lee Remick) joins him in Spain, but when an insurance investigator (Alan Bates) arrives unexpectedly, Rex's paranoia causes him to flee again.

programme.title: Cat Ballou
programme.desc: When hired gun Tim Strawn (Lee Marvin) kills her rancher father, Cat Ballou (Jane Fonda) becomes an outlaw set on vengeance. Enlisting the help of washed-up gunslinger Kid Shelleen (also Marvin) as well as the handsome bandit Clay Boone (Michael Callan), Cat strikes back at the land-development company that employed Strawn, and eventually targets the assassin himself. Adding to the lively comedic mood of the film are narrative song performances by Nat King Cole and Stubby Kaye.

programme.title: SUMtv Sabbath School Hour
programme.desc: Our weekly Sabbath School Hour is deisgned to help you strengthen your understanding of God's word as we go through the quarterly Sabbath School Lessons together.

programme.title: SUMtv Worship Hour
programme.sub-title: Prophets and Time Prophecies - Pr. Stephen Bohr
programme.desc: SUMtv Worship Hour is a weekly series that features a variety of speakers who earnestly present deep, edifying sermons based on the Word of God. Each sermon offers a different message using biblical prophecy, Christian doctrine, the present truth, practical Christian living, and biblical teachings through the lens of history. Tune in to find encouragement for strengthening your faith, renewing your spirit and living in harmony with God's will.

programme.title: Scripture, Church Structure, and the Path to Unity Symposium
programme.desc: This symposium will address ecclesiastical and administrative issues that have arisen since San Antonio, such as: Is the General Conference administration attempting to force Unions into compliance with the vote of the world church in San Antonio? How does church policy relate to the worldwide unity of the church? Is compliance with denominational church policy merely optional? What is the foundation for the unity of the church? These and other hot-button topics are addressed in this symposium.

programme.title: Adverum Productions - Journeys
programme.sub-title: Dan's Journey: Finding The Meaning of Life
programme.desc: Having landed his dream job at a blue chip company, Dan thought he had it all: interesting hobbies, friends, popularity and money. He had attained what he thought would make him happy, but he was not fulfilled. Was this the meaning of life? His atheist worldview starts to feel less stable after encountering several Christians and some intriguing new ideas. He eventually has to make some tough decisions regarding his career, but ends up finding the purpose for his life in the most unexpected place. Follow this remarkable journey from unbelief to fervent faith.

programme.title: Anchor 2024: The Great Prophecies of the Old Testament Part II
programme.desc: Anchor is a seminary-level course of study on the fundamentals of Seventh-day Adventist theology, taught by Pastor Stephen Bohr. The mission of ANCHOR is to settle students into the Truth both intellectually and spiritually and provide the theological skills to share with others the reason for the hope that is in them. Will your anchor hold in the coming storm?

programme.title: Being Woman
programme.desc: Being Woman is an empowering educational series that delves into the intricacies of women's health. Whether tackling menstrual irregularities, fertility concerns, hormone imbalance, or just wanting to understand the female anatomy, this series gives viewers a deeper understanding of the body, mind and spirit connection. We hope you find encouragment to embrace every health journey with faith and reverence.

programme.title: The 24 Elders
programme.desc: There has been much discussion in the Seventh-day Adventist church about the identity of the 24 elders. Some believe that they represent those who resurrected with Jesus. Others believe that they are the highest of angels. Who is this select group and what is their function in the heavenly courts? What lessons do they teach us regarding God's mode of operating the universe? These and other questions are clearly answered in this ground-breaking series.

programme.title: Misinterpreted Texts on the State of the Dead
programme.desc: We live in a world captivated by the supernatural. Spiritualism has deeply influenced our media and entertainment. But what does the Bible actually teach about the state of the dead? Does the soul depart from the body at death? Are the righteous in heaven praising God? Are the wicked currently suffering in hell? In this enlightening series, Pastor Stephen Bohr explores these vital questions and more, offering clear, biblical answers about death and the afterlife.

programme.title: Born Again
programme.sub-title: How Can I Be Born of the Spirit?
programme.desc: What does it really mean to be "born again"? Is there a line between convinced and converted Adventits? In this seven-part series Dojcin Zivadinovic discusses what true conversion looks like according to the Bible and how we can all experience this re-birth.

programme.title: Timless Healing Insights - Bible Biographies
programme.desc: David's relationship to Jonathan's son, Mephibosheth, provides powerful insights into the ministry of our risen Savior.

programme.title: Divine Design

Eric Wilson was a former practitioner and teacher in Asian martial arts, Tai-chi, Qigong and Traditional Chinese Medicine for 25 years. programme.title: Twelve Monkeys
programme.desc: A psychiatrist (Madeleine Stowe) finally believes a patient (Bruce Willis) who claims to be a time-traveler sent to 1996 to prevent a virulent holocaust.","large":"Traveling back in time isn't simple, as James Cole (Bruce Willis) learns the hard way. Imprisoned in the 2030s, James is recruited for a mission that will send him back to the 1990s. Once there, he's supposed to gather information about a nascent plague that's about to exterminate the vast majority of the world's population. But, aside from the manic Jeffrey (Brad Pitt), he gets little in the way of cooperation, not least from medical gatekeepers like Dr. Kathryn Railly (Madeleine Stowe).

programme.title: The Hunted
programme.desc: A New York businessman (Christopher Lambert) witnesses the murder of a mystery woman (Joan Chen) by a ninja assassin (John Lone) in Japan.","large":"New York executive Paul Racine is on a business trip in Japan when he meets the stunning, enigmatic Kirina. They spend the night together in her hotel room, and Racine returns the next day to retrieve his forgotten keys. But once he's there, he witnesses Kirina's assassination by Kinjo, the leader of a ninja cult. Realizing that Racine has seen everything, Kinjo will do everything in his power to end the executive's life.

programme.title: The Truth About Charlie
programme.desc: A woman (Thandie Newton) meets a charming stranger (Mark Wahlberg), then deals with her mysterious husband's murder and his link to missing money.","large":"Regina (Thandie Newton) meets charming Joshua (Mark Wahlberg) while vacationing in Martinique, as she contemplates ending her whirlwind marriage to enigmatic Charlie (Stephen Dillane). Then upon her return to Paris, she finds that both her apartment and her bank account have been emptied, and her husband has been murdered. The more Reggie learns, the more she realizes the scope of the puzzle, which she must solve to protect herself from ever-increasing danger.

programme.title: American Pie
programme.desc: Four teenage boys enter a pact to lose their virginity by prom night.

programme.title: The Andromeda Strain
programme.desc: Scientists (Arthur Hill, David Wayne, James Olson) rush to isolate an alien germ brought back by a space probe.","large":"Chilling tale about a US research satellite carrying a deadly extraterrestrial microscopic organism that crashes into a small town in Arizona. A group of top scientists are hurriedly assembled in a bid to identify and contain the lethal stowaway. Based on the novel by Michael Crichton.

programme.title: Bustin' Loose
programme.desc: An ex-convict (Richard Pryor) takes handicapped orphans and their teacher (Cicely Tyson) from Philadelphia to Washington state by bus.","large":"Parole officer Donald (Robert Christian) compels his foul-mouthed ex-con charge Joe Braxton (Richard Pryor) to escort a bus full of special education students from Philadelphia to the Pacific Northwest, where their teacher Vivian Perry (Cicely Tyson) plans to set up a new school. But when Braxton's latest attempt at going straight becomes a frustrating series of mishaps, he struggles to complete the job he was hired to do while resisting his growing affection for Vivian and the children.

programme.title: Army of Darkness
programme.desc: Because of a time warp, a supermarket worker finds himself fighting in medieval England with a chainsaw and a '73 Oldsmobile.

programme.title: Land of the Dead
programme.desc: A mercenary leader (Simon Baker) squares off with a rebellious comrade (John Leguizamo), while flesh-eating zombies threaten their fortified city.","large":"In a world where zombies form the majority of the population, the remaining humans build a feudal society away from the undead. Ruthless Paul Kaufman (Dennis Hopper) rules and protects this microcosm but enforces painful class distinctions. Second-in-command Cholo DeMora (John Leguizamo) attempts to lead a secret rebellion against Kaufman's tyranny, but when the zombies begin to evolve, the survivors must discover a way to protect themselves from a zombie horde that can learn and adapt.

programme.title: Darkman II: The Return of Durant
programme.desc: Crime lord Robert G. Durant (Larry Drake) awakens from a coma and again destroys disfigured Darkman's (Arnold Vosloo) liquid-skin laboratory.","large":"Scientist Peyton Westlake (Arnold Vosloo) returns to his lab believing he has disposed of his nemesis, mobster Robert G. Durant (Larry Drake), who gave him the hideous burns that transformed him into his alter ego, Darkman. While Darkman is perfecting an artificial skin that will restore his old appearance, Durant inexplicably returns to torment him. Overcome by rage, Darkman disguises himself with the artificial skin, setting out to infiltrate Durant's world and bring him to justice.

programme.title: Serenity
programme.desc: Crew members (Nathan Fillion, Gina Torres, Alan Tudyk) aboard a transport vessel get caught in a deadly conflict in the wake of a galactic war.","large":"In this continuation of the television series "Firefly," a group of rebels travels the outskirts of space aboard their ship, Serenity, outside the reach of the Alliance, a sinister regime that controls most of the universe. After the crew takes in Simon (Sean Maher) and his psychic sister, River (Summer Glau), whom he has just rescued from Alliance forces, they find themselves being pursued by the Operative (Chiwetel Ejiofor), an Alliance agent who will stop at nothing to find them.

programme.title: Pitch Black
programme.desc: Passengers marooned on a remote planet soon learn that their only hope from the deadly creatures lurking in the dark is a dangerous escaped convict. Starring Vin Diesel and Radha Mitchell.","large":"When their ship crashes on an unexplored planet, the survivors of the crash soon discover that this planet that is normally always day is going to soon be in a state of eclipse that will bring out deadly nocturnal creatures. Will a prison convict (Vin Diesel) being transported on the ship end up being the one man who can lead the survivors off the planet?

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: Two weeks before he is scheduled to depart from devastated planet Earth forever, a drone repairman rescues a woman from a downed spaceship, triggering a final battle to save mankind.","large":"In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a security repairman on an Earth left empty and devastated after a war with aliens. Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: An ancient Egyptian princess is awakened from her crypt beneath the desert, bringing with her malevolence grown over millennia, and terrors that defy human comprehension.","large":"Nick Morton is a soldier of fortune who plunders ancient sites for timeless artifacts and sells them to the highest bidder. When Nick and his partner come under attack in the Middle East, the ensuing battle accidentally unearths Ahmanet, a betrayed Egyptian princess who was entombed under the desert for thousands of years. With her powers constantly evolving, Morton must now stop the resurrected monster as she embarks on a furious rampage through the streets of London.

programme.title: The Scorpion King 2: Rise of a Warrior
programme.desc: To avenge his father's death, a young man (Michael Copon) embarks on a quest against a king (Randy Couture).","large":"After a swarm of enchanted scorpions kills his father, Mathayus (Michael Copon) flees and vows to even the score with ruthless sorcerer Sargon (Randy Couture). Upon returning home after years of combat training, Mathayus finds that Sargon has seized the crown and protected himself with a powerful spell. To retrieve the only weapon capable of destroying the tyrant -- a mystical sword -- Mathayus and lady warrior Layla (Karen David) set off for a labyrinth guarded by a deadly Minotaur.

programme.title: The Scorpion King 4: Quest for Power
programme.desc: Mathayus is framed for the murder of the king of Norvania, and he and his allies have to stop the evil heir from finding a mythical power.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: An ancient Egyptian princess is awakened from her crypt beneath the desert, bringing with her malevolence grown over millennia, and terrors that defy human comprehension.","large":"Nick Morton is a soldier of fortune who plunders ancient sites for timeless artifacts and sells them to the highest bidder. When Nick and his partner come under attack in the Middle East, the ensuing battle accidentally unearths Ahmanet, a betrayed Egyptian princess who was entombed under the desert for thousands of years. With her powers constantly evolving, Morton must now stop the resurrected monster as she embarks on a furious rampage through the streets of London.

programme.title: The Watcher
programme.desc: A traumatized FBI agent (James Spader) comes out of hiding to catch a serial killer (Keanu Reeves) who sends him pictures of his intended victims before he strikes.","large":"The Watcher is an exciting psychological thriller that takes a unique look into the minds of both a serial killer and the man who must, reluctantly, pursue him. In an almost Hitchcockian way, the film quickly introduces us to the killer, David Allen Griffin, played by Keanu Reeves, who for many years, preyed on lonely young women in the Los Angeles area. The story is set up to create a taut cat-and-mouse game between Griffin and FBI agent Joel Campbell.

programme.title: Black Christmas
programme.desc: As sorority sisters prepare for holiday parties, a mysterious cloaked figure starts to leave a bloody trail throughout their campus. Refusing to become victims, the girls decide to band together and fight back against the psychotic Christmas killer.","large":"Hawthorne College is quieting down for the holidays as students travel home to spend time with their families. But as Riley and her sorority sisters prepare to deck the halls with seasonal parties, a mysterious cloaked figure starts to leave a bloody trail throughout the campus. Refusing to become hapless victims, Riley and her friends decide to band together and fight back against the psychotic Christmas killer.

programme.title: Dead Silence
programme.desc: After his wife meets a grisly end, a man (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their haunted hometown and uncovers a supernatural link to her death.","large":"After his wife meets a grisly end, Jamie Ashen (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their creepy hometown of Ravens Fair to unravel the mystery of her murder. Once there, he discovers the legend of Mary Shaw (Joan Heney), a murdered ventriloquist whose eerie presence still looms over the town. As he desperately digs for answers, Jamie encounters the curse that took his wife's life and threatens his own.

programme.title: The Unborn
programme.desc: With the help of a spiritualist (Gary Oldman), a woman (Odette Yustman) uncovers a family curse dating back to Nazi Germany and involving a demonic spirit with the power to inhabit anything or anyone.","large":"Plagued by nightmares and visitations from tortured ghosts, Casey Beldon turns to a spiritual adviser named Sendak for help. They discover a family curse that dates back to Nazi Germany: an evil spirit that can take over the body of anyone and is getting stronger with each possession, as it tries to gain full entrance to this world.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: While investigating the disappearance of her twin sister, a young American encounters the tormented spirits of Japan's mysterious and legendary Aokigahara Forest.","large":"When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Slither
programme.desc: A small-town sheriff (Nathan Fillion) and his team encounter waves of wormlike alien organisms that are intent on devouring all life on Earth.","large":"Wheelsy is a small town where not much happens and everyone minds his own business. programme.title: Devil
programme.desc: As frightening events unfold, five strangers realize they are trapped in an elevator with Lucifer himself.","large":"Five strangers' day begins with an elevator ride in a Philadelphia office tower. But, what happens next is anything but ordinary. The elevator gets stuck, and the trapped passengers, who expected to be together just a few minutes, now face the revelation of their secrets and transgressions. Frightening events turn annoyance into terror, as they begin to realize that one of their number is Lucifer himself.

programme.title: The Visit
programme.desc: Grandma's rules: 1. Have a great time. 2. Eat as much as you want. 3. Don't ever leave your room after 9:30 pm.","large":"Becca and younger brother Tyler say goodbye to their mother as they board a train and head deep into Pennsylvania farm country to meet their maternal grandparents for the first time. Welcomed by Nana and Pop Pop, all seems well until the siblings start to notice increasingly strange behavior from the seemingly charming couple. Once the children discover a shocking secret, they begin to wonder if they'll ever make it home.

programme.title: The Frighteners
programme.desc: Friendly ghosts help a psychic detective (Michael J. Fox) probe the hauntings that killed residents of a coastal California town.","large":"Once an architect, Frank Bannister (Michael J. Fox) now passes himself off as an exorcist of evil spirits. To bolster his facade, he claims his "special" gift is the result of a car accident that killed his wife. But what he does not count on is more people dying in the small town where he lives. As he tries to piece together the supernatural mystery of these killings, he falls in love with the wife (Trini Alvarado) of one of the victims and deals with a crazy FBI agent (Jeffrey Combs).

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: An anthropologist (Timothy Hutton) protects a confused Neanderthal man (John Lone) who has been thawed back to life.","large":"On an Arctic expedition, Stanley Shepard discovers Charlie, a Neanderthal man frozen in ice. With a team of scientists, Shepard revives Charlie and learns that he has been cryogenically suspended for 40,000 years. Stanley grows close to Charlie as he observes the man and learns about his prehistoric culture -- but when the media catches on to the discovery, Stanley must protect Charlie from fellow scientists who want to use his corpse for scientific research.

programme.title: Sssssss
programme.desc: A snake scientist (Strother Martin) turns his daughter's (Heather Menzies) boyfriend (Dirk Benedict), his lab helper, into a big cobra.","large":"Short on cash, undergrad David Blake (Dirk Benedict) takes a job working as a lab assistant for snake expert Dr. Carl Stoner (Strother Martin). When Stoner begins giving David a series of antibiotics as a safeguard against snakebites, he at first thinks nothing of it. But gradually David begins to notice curious changes in his body, and his new girlfriend, Dr. Stoner's daughter, Kristina (Heather Menzies), notices them too. Could Dr. Stoner really be trying to turn his assistant into a snake?

programme.title: The Andromeda Strain
programme.desc: Scientists (Arthur Hill, David Wayne, James Olson) rush to isolate an alien germ brought back by a space probe.","large":"Chilling tale about a US research satellite carrying a deadly extraterrestrial microscopic organism that crashes into a small town in Arizona. programme.title: Junior

programme.title: Twins
programme.desc: A genetically perfected specimen (Arnold Schwarzenegger) meets his pint-size, wise-guy long-lost twin (Danny DeVito).","large":"The products of a genetic experiment, fraternal twins Julius (Arnold Schwarzenegger) and Vincent (Danny DeVito) are separated at birth. Julius, raised by a scientist (Tony Jay), grows up humble, intelligent and strong, but very naive about the larger world. When Julius learns of his mother and brother, he heads to Los Angeles to find his family.

programme.title: Bird on a Wire

programme.title: Doomsday

programme.title: Roadworthy Rescues
programme.desc: Derek heads to a scrapyard to find a retired tow truck he can use around the shop; this 1979 Dodge D300 proves reluctant to go anywhere; Derek will have to hotwire the entire electrical system if he has any hope of making it home.

programme.title: Grande fratello VIP
programme.desc: Chi tra Jonathan Kashanian, Giacomo Gallani, Marina La Rosa, Megan Ria, Andreas Muller e Moreno Morello dovrà abbandonare la casa? Il pubblico decreterà il secondo eliminato della stagione.

programme.title: Grande fratello VIP: Live
programme.desc: In diretta dalla casa di Cinecittà, le telecamere seguono gli inquilini protagonisti della nuova edizione de 'Il grande fratello VIP', impegnati nell'accattivarsi le simpatie del pubblico.

programme.title: Dritto e rovescio
programme.desc: Periodico di approfondimento giornalistico dedicato principalmente ad attualità e politica.

programme.title: 10 Minuti
programme.desc: Dieci minuti per focalizzarsi sui fatti principali della giornata, con interviste e dibattiti sui temi più rilevanti di attualità, politica, economia.

programme.title: Tira e molla
programme.desc: Show ideato da Corrado Mantoni. Due coppie di concorrenti si sfidano in 4 prove per accumulare il montepremi più alto. Ma nell'ultimo gioco la situazione si può completamente capovolgere.

programme.title: Sport Mediaset
programme.desc: Telegiornale sportivo: novità, anticipazioni, collegamenti in diretta e servizi in esclusiva. Il programma erede di 'Studio Sport' continua a portare nelle case degli italiani le più aggiornate e complete informazioni sul mondo dell'agonismo.

programme.title: Tg4: Diario del giorno
programme.desc: Le principali notizie del momento a cura della redazione della rete. Aggiornamenti e approfondimenti riguardanti politica, cronaca, esteri, economia, sport e attualità.

programme.title: Realpolitik
programme.desc: Tommaso Labate conduce il nuovo programma di informazione. Sondaggi, retroscena e analisi in tempo reale, per raccontare la politica e l'attualità senza filtri.

programme.title: Forum
programme.desc: Il processo tv che affronta vicende comuni e quotidiane con uno sguardo sempre attento ai temi più attuali. Spazio anche per il confronto dedicato alle cause più complesse, in un dialogo tra generazioni diverse.

programme.title: Lo sportello di Forum
programme.desc: La sessione pomeridiana del tribunale televisivo di Forum: due cittadini affidano la soluzione delle proprie dispute e dei propri contenziosi affidandosi a un giudice e alla legge dello stato.

programme.title: Madri: Una vita di amore
programme.desc: Elsa raggiunge la maggiore età e Marian teme che, in caso di dimissioni, potrebbe non rivederla più. Elsa rimane ferma nel suo intento di escludere la madre dalla sua vita.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Grande fratello VIP: Live
programme.desc: In diretta dalla casa di Cinecittà, le telecamere seguono gli inquilini protagonisti della nuova edizione de 'Il grande fratello VIP', impegnati nell'accattivarsi le simpatie del pubblico.

programme.title: Caduta libera
programme.desc: Un concorrente al centro dello studio, sopra una botola, rischia di cadere alla prima risposta sbagliata. A sfidarlo, dieci avversari pronti a incorrere nella stessa sorte in un duello a suon di domande.

programme.title: Tg5
programme.desc: Edizione del notiziario televisivo a cura della redazione giornalistica di Canale 5. Dal 13 gennaio 1992, ogni giorno, le notizie più importanti a livello nazionale e internazionale.

programme.title: Sport Mediaset

programme.title: Russlands Gewalt-Problem
programme.desc: Im russischen Alltagsleben ist Gewalt genauso allgegenwärtig wie im Machtapparat. Auch unter den Bürgern gilt meist das Recht des Stärkeren. Immer mehr Menschen wollen das allerdings nicht mehr hinnehmen. Sie wünschen sich ein anderes Russland.

programme.title: Vorbild Natur
programme.desc: Für einige Menschen sind Insekten nur lästige Krabbeltiere. Doch für viele Forscher sind sie kleine Genies, die dabei helfen können, einige der größten Probleme zu lösen. Die Sendung widmet sich den Vorbildern Ameise, Kartoffelkäfer und Marienkäfer.

programme.title: 42 - Die Antwort auf fast alles
programme.desc: Ohne Zweifel hat Hass eine zerstörerische Kraft. Hass ist zielgerichtet und destruktiv. Aber hat der Hass eigentlich auch einen Sinn? Warum hassen Menschen überhaupt? Viele Fragen, und die Wissenschaft hat längst noch nicht alle beantwortet.

programme.title: 42 - Die Antwort auf fast alles
programme.desc: Wissenschaftler aus den Bereichen Quantenphysik, Stringtheorie und Astrophysik machen deutlich, dass eine Zeitreise theoretisch möglich ist - zumindest, wenn es in die Zukunft gehen soll. Es wird beleuchtet, was die Voraussetzungen dafür sind.

programme.title: 42 - Die Antwort auf fast alles
programme.desc: Pilze sind kaum erforscht. Dabei gehören sie zu den ältesten und vielfältigsten Lebensformen des Planeten. Erst durch Pilze konnten sich vor Urzeiten Pflanzen entwickeln. Sie sind überall zu Hause: in der Erde, in der Luft und in Körpern.

programme.title: 42 - Die Antwort auf fast alles
programme.desc: Ein Leben ohne Farben ist kaum vorstellbar, weder für uns Menschen noch für zahlreiche Tier- und Pflanzenarten. Der Film erklärt, woher die Macht der Farben kommt und wie man es schafft, sie am besten zu nutzen.

programme.title: Mind Matters - Die 5 größten Geheimnisse deines Gehirns
programme.desc: Wir begeben uns auf eine Reise in das menschliche Gehirn, die fünf zentrale Erkenntnisse enthüllt.

programme.title: Body Code - Die 5 größten Geheimnisse deines Körpers
programme.desc: Der menschliche Körper ist ein Wunderwerk voller verborgener Kräfte. So werden überraschende Phänomene rund um den Körper vorgestellt, die das Verständnis von Gesundheit komplett auf den Kopf stellen, wie etwa Fett, das Fett verbrennt.

programme.title: Tierisch gute Augen
programme.desc: Professor Thomas Cronin erklärt, wie Tiere die Welt visuell wahrnehmen. Außerdem geht es darum, wie das, was sie sehen, den Platz der Tiere in der Natur beeinflusst und wie ihr Platz in der Natur beeinflusst, was sie sehen.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: James Rath kehrt nach Los Angeles zurück, wo er vor der Pandemie zu Hause war. Dort trifft er alte Freunde wieder, die in der Unterhaltungsindustrie im Bereich Barrierefreiheit arbeiten. Außerdem genießt er ein koreanisches Barbecue und geht surfen.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: Nach einer überraschenden Einladung, den Leiter der Abteilung für Barrierefreiheit in der Microsoft-Zentrale in Seattle zu besuchen, macht sich James auf den Weg nach Vancouver. Die Stadt gilt als barrierefreieste Stadt der Welt.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: Wie steht es um die Barrierefreiheit in New York City, einer der größten Städte der Welt? James Rath stürzt sich in ein Abenteuer im Big Apple, um herauszufinden, ob er sich dort als Blinder durchschlagen kann.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: James Rath fliegt über den großen Teich, um herauszufinden, wie gut man als blinder Reisender in London zurechtkommt. In der multikulturellen Metropole macht er sich mit der britisch-indischen Küche vertraut und lernt eine neue Sportart kennen.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: James Rath nimmt den Zug hinein in das ländliche Großbritannien, um die Barrierefreiheit zu prüfen. Sein Weg führt über Gruseltouren mit Wandern in Schottland über Fußball in Liverpool bis hin zu einem aufregenden Fahrgeschäft in Wales.

programme.title: Mit dem Rucksack durch Nepal
programme.desc: Die Brüder Dennis und Patrick Weinert begeben sich auf eine dreimonatige Reise durch Nepal. Neben Abenteuern im Dschungel und auf Bergen treffen die Brüder auch auf Einheimische und reden mit ihnen über die Beziehung von Mensch und Natur.

programme.title: Abenteuer Israel - Zu Fuß durch ein begehrtes Land
programme.desc: Die Reportage begleitet zwei junge Deutsche, Kim und Eike, bei ihrer Wanderung durch Israel. Sie sprechen mit jungen Israelis darüber, was es heute für sie bedeutet, jüdisch zu sein. Der letzte Teil der Reise führt die beiden durch die Wüste Negev.

programme.title: Re:
programme.desc: Albanien wurde lange mit Kriminalität, Korruption und der Abwanderung der Bevölkerung in Verbindung gebracht. Mittlerweile entwickelt sich das Land an der Adria nicht nur zur interessanten Urlaubsdestination, sondern auch zu einem Auswanderer-Ziel.

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: Klimaschutz oder Krawall? Der Widerstand der Letzten Generation
programme.desc: Die Klima-Aktivisten der Letzten Generation sorgen seit über einem Jahr für jede Menge Aufmerksamkeit: Maja Winkelmann und Henning Jeschke, von Anfang an dabei, sind überzeugt: Es ist das letzte Mittel, um die Erde vor dem Untergang zu retten.

programme.title: Titans of Defense
programme.desc: In befreundeten und feindlichen Gewässern verfügen die am feinsten abgestimmten Kriegsschiffe und U-Boote der Militärgeschichte über Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen Tarnfähigkeit, Geschwindigkeit, Tragfähigkeit und Angriffsstärke.

programme.title: Titans of Defense
programme.desc: Ob sie wichtige Versorgungsgüter zum Schlachtfeld fliegen, über Kampfeinsätzen schweben oder internationale Missionen unter schwierigsten Bedingungen durchführen: Militärhubschrauber sind für ihre Aufgaben bestens gerüstet.

programme.title: Geniale Mega-Maschinen
programme.desc: Die Sendung befasst sich mit großen Maschinen der Luftfahrt. Stählerne Kolosse wie das Militärtransportflugzeug C5 Galaxy, ein Flugzeug mit einer enorm hohen Ladekapazität, übersteigen dabei die Vorstellungskraft der modernen Technik.

programme.title: Die Leoparden von Yala
programme.desc: In dem Yala-Nationalpark kommt es in der großen Leoparden-Population zu Rangeleien. Die männlichen Leoparden wollen ihr Territorium beschützen und kämpfen um Paarungsrechte, während die Weibchen das Überleben ihrer Jungen sichern wollen.

programme.title: Unter Löwen
programme.desc: Im afrikanischen Tansania prallen die Welt der Löwen und die der Menschen aufeinander. Während der Trockenzeit in der Nähe der Serengeti bedrohen hungrige Löwen die Existenz des Viehzüchters Rugari und die seiner Familie.

programme.title: Strandwolf
programme.desc: Die deutsche Wissenschaftlerin Ingrid Wiesel widmet ihr Leben der Erforschung der scheuen Schabrackenhyäne. An den kargen Küsten Afrikas kämpft sie für das Überleben dieser seltenen Raubtiere und liefert faszinierende Einblicke in deren Alltag.

programme.title: Geheimnisse des Yellowstone
programme.desc: Im US-Bundesstaat Montana liegt in den Sedimentablagerungen eine der reichsten Ansammlungen an Fossilien aus der Kreidezeit. Hier wurden berühmte Dinosaurier entdeckt, nun auch der vollständig erhaltene Schädel eines Triceratops.

programme.title: Neue Heimat Mars
programme.desc: In der Sendung erklärt der Evolutionsbiologe Scott Solomon, welche Anpassungen das Leben auf einem anderen Planeten erfordern wird. So könnten sich die Bewohner des Mars gegenüber denen der Erde hinsichtlich der Größe von Herz und Kopf unterscheiden.

programme.title: Neue Heimat Mars
programme.desc: Die Reise zum Nachbarplaneten folgt einem Pfad, der Nikola Tesla, Nazi-Kriegswaffen, ein Weltraumrennen im Kalten Krieg und eine Reihe von bahnbrechenden Entdeckungen einiger der talentiertesten Roboter der NASA verbindet.

programme.title: Neue Heimat Mars
programme.desc: Die Sendung fragt, wie das Leben auf dem roten Planeten aussehen könnte. Dabei geht es um die Frage, wie der Mensch in einer Umgebung mit ungewohnt hoher Strahlenbelastung und giftigem Staub ausreichend Nahrung, Wasser und Schutz finden kann.

programme.desc: Die Moderatoren erkunden Nantes auf einem mechanischen Elefanten und Inlineskates.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Cody verlässt die üblichen Touristenpfade und rennt auf einem Eisenbahnfriedhof über Waggons.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh entdeckt verlassene Stahl- und Bergwerksfabriken im industriellen Ruhrgebiet in Deutschland.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Cody besucht die Isle of Wight in England und will das Leben vor Ort kennenlernen. Bei seiner Erkundung der Umgebung besucht er unter anderem einen mittelalterlichen Leuchtturm und ein verfallenes Ferienresort auf der Insel.

programme.title: Penny auf der Reeperbahn
programme.desc: Die Penny-Filiale auf der Reeperbahn ist der wohl berühmteste Supermarkt Deutschlands und ist Lebensmittelgeschäft und Party Location zugleich. Wenn die Bars und Clubs der Meile schließen, wird der Discounter zum Meeting Point der Szenegänger.

programme.title: Penny auf der Reeperbahn
programme.desc: Für einen Supermarkt inmitten der Reeperbahn ist Chaos vorprogrammiert. So wird einem Stofftier Schnaps in den Mund gekippt und an der Kassenschlange werden Frauen in die Luft gehoben. Da wird dem ein oder anderen auch mal Hausverbot erteilt.

programme.title: Die Pennymarkt-Promis vom Kiez
programme.desc: Der Penny-Markt auf der Reeperbahn wird auch von Prominenten und schrill-schillernden Kunden besucht. Eine von ihnen ist die Künstlerin Christine Licht, die vor 17 Jahren durch ihre Tanzkünste vor dem Obst- und Gemüseregal schlagartig bekannt wurde.

programme.title: Ich kauf mir ein Schloss
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation stellt Menschen vor, die ihren Traum vom Leben in einem der vielen Schlösser in Europa verwirklichen. Der Kaufpreis ist oft ein Schnäppchen. Doch die "Schlossrettung" wird zur Lebensaufgabe mit vielen Überraschungen.

programme.title: Gärten des Grauens
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation setzt sich mit dem umweltfeindlichen Trend hin zum Steingarten auseinander.

programme.title: Libellen: Funkelnde Jäger
programme.desc: Libellen schillern wie Schmetterlinge, jagen unter wie über der Wasseroberfläche und sind Flugkünstler, von denen sich selbst Kolibris etwas abschauen könnten. Sie existierten lange vor den Dinosauriern. Es wird ihrem Erfolgsgeheimnis nachgegangen.

programme.title: Abenteuer Deutschland
programme.desc: Die Sendung schaut auf die idyllische Natur in Deutschland und zeigt dafür die schönsten Seen und Flüsse des Landes. Außerdem schaut sie auf die uralten Wälder und seine verschiedene Bewohner wie Wildschweine, Luchse und Wölfe.

programme.title: Tracker Diaries - Die Bären von Alaska
programme.desc: Im Herbst ereignet sich im nördlichen Pazifik ein Naturschauspiel. Tausende Lachse kehren in die Laichgebiete des Katmai-Nationalparks zurück. Braunbären nutzen die Migration aus und schlagen sich vor dem Winterschlaf den Bauch voll.

programme.title: Tracker Diaries - Die Bären von Alaska
programme.desc: Casey Anderson folgt Bärenfamilien, die während der Lachsmigration fischen gehen. Tausende Lachse kehren in ihre Laichgebiete zurück und die Bären haben viele verschiedene Techniken entwickelt, um an die begehrten Fische zu gelangen.

programme.title: Tracker Diaries - Die Bären von Alaska

programme.desc: Im US-Bundesstaat Montana liegt in den Sedimentablagerungen eine der reichsten Ansammlungen an Fossilien aus der Kreidezeit. Hier wurden berühmte Dinosaurier entdeckt, nun auch der vollständig erhaltene Schädel eines Triceratops.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: James Rath kehrt nach Los Angeles zurück, wo er vor der Pandemie zu Hause war. Dort trifft er alte Freunde wieder, die in der Unterhaltungsindustrie im Bereich Barrierefreiheit arbeiten. Außerdem genießt er ein koreanisches Barbecue und geht surfen.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: Nach einer überraschenden Einladung, den Leiter der Abteilung für Barrierefreiheit in der Microsoft-Zentrale in Seattle zu besuchen, macht sich James auf den Weg nach Vancouver. Die Stadt gilt als barrierefreieste Stadt der Welt.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: Wie steht es um die Barrierefreiheit in New York City, einer der größten Städte der Welt? James Rath stürzt sich in ein Abenteuer im Big Apple, um herauszufinden, ob er sich dort als Blinder durchschlagen kann.

programme.title: Abenteuer Israel - Zu Fuß durch ein begehrtes Land
programme.desc: Die Reportage begleitet zwei junge Deutsche, Kim und Eike, bei ihrer Wanderung durch Israel. Sie sprechen mit jungen Israelis darüber, was es heute für sie bedeutet, jüdisch zu sein. Der letzte Teil der Reise führt die beiden durch die Wüste Negev.

programme.title: Ein Mammut-Projekt - Wiedergeburt ausgestorbener Arten
programme.desc: Weltweit arbeiten Forscher daran, verschwundene Tierarten neu zu erschaffen. Mammut und Beutelwolf sollen zurückkehren. Mit modernen Bio- und Gentechniken gewinnen sie aus Museumsexponaten Baupläne ihres verloren geglaubten Erbguts.

programme.title: Libellen: Funkelnde Jäger
programme.desc: Libellen schillern wie Schmetterlinge, jagen unter wie über der Wasseroberfläche und sind Flugkünstler, von denen sich selbst Kolibris etwas abschauen könnten. Sie existierten lange vor den Dinosauriern. Es wird ihrem Erfolgsgeheimnis nachgegangen.

programme.title: Abenteuer Deutschland
programme.desc: Die Sendung schaut auf die idyllische Natur in Deutschland und zeigt dafür die schönsten Seen und Flüsse des Landes. Außerdem schaut sie auf die uralten Wälder und seine verschiedene Bewohner wie Wildschweine, Luchse und Wölfe.

programme.title: Tracker Diaries - Die Bären von Alaska
programme.desc: Im Herbst ereignet sich im nördlichen Pazifik ein Naturschauspiel. Tausende Lachse kehren in die Laichgebiete des Katmai-Nationalparks zurück. Braunbären nutzen die Migration aus und schlagen sich vor dem Winterschlaf den Bauch voll.

programme.title: Tracker Diaries - Die Bären von Alaska
programme.desc: Casey Anderson folgt Bärenfamilien, die während der Lachsmigration fischen gehen. Tausende Lachse kehren in ihre Laichgebiete zurück und die Bären haben viele verschiedene Techniken entwickelt, um an die begehrten Fische zu gelangen.

programme.title: Tracker Diaries - Die Bären von Alaska
programme.desc: Im Herbst wandern Tausende von Lachsen aus dem nördlichen Pazifik zurück zum Katmai-Nationalpark. Die große Population der Braunbären schlägt sich dann die Bäuche mit Fisch voll, um sich auf den Winterschlaf vorzubereiten.

programme.title: Ein Leben unter Affen
programme.desc: Es ist eine einzigartige Langzeitbeobachtung des Biologen Wolfgang Dittus, der seit 50 Jahren die Hutaffen in der alten Tempelstadt Polonnaruwa in Sri Lanka studiert. Er präsentiert faszinierende Einblicke in ihr Gesellschaftsleben.

programme.title: Wilde Insel Borneo
programme.desc: In dieser Dokumentation geht es um die außergewöhnliche Artenvielfalt auf Borneo. Dabei zählen unter anderem Orang-Utans bis hin zu Malaienbären zu den beheimateten Tierarten, die das tropische Inselreich für sich beanspruchen.

programme.title: Die Leoparden von Yala
programme.desc: In dem Yala-Nationalpark kommt es in der großen Leoparden-Population zu Rangeleien. Die männlichen Leoparden wollen ihr Territorium beschützen und kämpfen um Paarungsrechte, während die Weibchen das Überleben ihrer Jungen sichern wollen.

programme.title: Unter Löwen
programme.desc: Im afrikanischen Tansania prallen die Welt der Löwen und die der Menschen aufeinander. Während der Trockenzeit in der Nähe der Serengeti bedrohen hungrige Löwen die Existenz des Viehzüchters Rugari und die seiner Familie.

programme.title: Strandwolf
programme.desc: Die deutsche Wissenschaftlerin Ingrid Wiesel widmet ihr Leben der Erforschung der scheuen Schabrackenhyäne. An den kargen Küsten Afrikas kämpft sie für das Überleben dieser seltenen Raubtiere und liefert faszinierende Einblicke in deren Alltag.

programme.title: Geheimnisse des Yellowstone
programme.desc: Im US-Bundesstaat Montana liegt in den Sedimentablagerungen eine der reichsten Ansammlungen an Fossilien aus der Kreidezeit. Hier wurden berühmte Dinosaurier entdeckt, nun auch der vollständig erhaltene Schädel eines Triceratops.

programme.title: Re:
programme.desc: Der Karpfen könnte zum neuen Trendfisch werden. Er hat die wohl niedrigste CO2-Bilanz aller Speisefische, kommt ohne Fischmehl und Antibiotika aus und gedeiht in heimischen Gewässern. Allerdings gilt der Karpfen als schlammig und voller Gräten.

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: Neue Fische fürs Mittelmeer - Aufzucht als letzte Rettung
programme.desc: Die Fischbestände im Mittelmeer sind drastisch zurückgegangen. In Marseille soll ein "Fisch-Kindergarten" dazu beitragen, dass sich auch selten gewordene Meerestiere geschützt entwickeln können und sich die Bestände wieder erholen.

programme.title: Re:
programme.desc: Das Thema der Sendung lautet "Die Papageientaucher-Patrouille auf Island".

programme.title: Neue Bäume und tote Hirsche: Die Aufforstung der Highlands
programme.desc: Um die neu gepflanzten Bäume in den schottischen Highlands zu schützen, haben Klimaschützer rund 15.000 Hirsche geschossen. Bei den ortsansässigen Jägern regt sich Widerstand. Sie fürchten um ihre Traditionen und wichtige Einnahmequellen.

programme.title: Hawai'i: Aus Feuer geboren
programme.desc: In Oahu drängen sich 350.000 Einwohner auf engstem Raum. Auf der drittgrößten Insel des Archipels befindet sich der legendäre Waikiki Beach. Vor den Küsten Oahus tummeln sich unzählige Haie im Pazifik. Sie sind enorm wichtig, werden aber gejagt.

programme.title: Hawai'i: Aus Feuer geboren
programme.desc: Nirgendwo sonst gibt es eine so große landschaftliche Vielfalt wie auf Hawaii, der am weitesten vom Festland abgelegenen Inselgruppe der Welt. Im Mittelpunkt steht Big Island, die größte und jüngste Insel des Archipels.

programme.title: Blut und Spiele für die Polizei: Fußball-EM in Deutschland
programme.desc: Vier Wochen hat Deutschland Fußball geschaut. Währenddessen hat die Berliner Polizei ohne Ende Überstunden gemacht. Denn Millionen Fans aus aller Herren Ländern im Griff zu haben, ist wie ein Sack euphorisierte und betrunkene Flöhe zu hüten.

programme.title: Raser-Paradies Deutschland
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation geht dem Recht auf Geschwindigkeitsrausch in Deutschland auf den Grund.

programme.title: Tödliche Autorennen
programme.desc: In deutschen Großstädten kommt es immer wieder zu illegalen Autorennen. Junge Männer fahren nachts durch die Straßen und präsentieren ihre aufgemotzten Autos. Regelmäßig werden auch Unbeteiligte mit hineingezogen, im schlimmsten Fall mit Todesfolge.

programme.title: Spiegel TV - Reportage
programme.sub-title: Zwischen Kult und Krawall - unser Kiez Frankfurt!
programme.desc: Das Frankfurter Bahnhofsviertel ist seit Jahren für die Drogenszene und die Gewaltübergriffe bekannt. Der Türsteher Mirko Ferenczy kennt die Gegend gut und beobachtet einen steten Anstieg an Gewalt in der Gegend der Innenstadt.

programme.title: Spiegel TV - Reportage
programme.sub-title: Zwischen Kult und Krawall - unser Kiez Hamburg!
programme.desc: In dem Hamburger Kiez steht der Wirt Daniel Schmidt seit 20 Jahren hinter der Theke. Auf der Reeperbahn gibt es unzählige Bars und Clubs sowie auch die Wunderbar, die bereits seit 32 Jahren ein fester Teil der schwulen Community ist.

programme.title: Löschen, retten, helfen
programme.desc: Die Feuerwehr Hamburg kann mehr als nur Brände löschen. Oft geht es um Leben und Tod. Mal haben es die Einsatzkräfte mit Weltkriegsbomben zu tun, mal mit Menschen, die einfach nur einsam sind. Die Reportage zeigt sie bei ihrer aufreibenden Arbeit.

programme.title: Premium
programme.desc: Reginald "Cool" Coolidge is an actor hoping for his big break away from stereotypical black roles. When his ex-fiancée, Charli, pulls in to the gas station where he works, Cool realizes that he still loves her after three years apart. But there is one problem: Charli's wedding to another man is only 36 hours away. Desperate to win her back, Cool uses his talents as an actor to convince Charli that she is choosing the wrong man.

Shear madness ensues as Henry, an animal-rights activist (Danielle Mason) and a farmhand (Tammy Davis) set out to stop the rampaging animals.

But while the duo is settling a debt with their promoter, Farnsworth (Henry Hall), thieves Pete (Al Ferguson) and Jim (Paul Fix) murder and rob Farnsworth and manage to pin the crimes on John and Charlie. The accused then flee, assume two new identities, take up with a shopkeeper named Anne (Mary Kornman) and set out to clear their names and bring the real killers to justice.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Senorita
programme.desc: Things go from bad to worse for singing cowboy Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) and his trusty companion, Teddy Bear (Guinn "Big Boy" Williams), when, after losing their jobs at a local café, the pair are accused of having kidnapped young Chip Williams (Mary Lee) who, in reality, is merely a runaway who's been tagging along with the cowpokes. But amidst these problems, Roy and his partner decide to team up with the girl and her half-sister, Ysobel (Dale Evans), and search for some long-buried treasure.

programme.title: The Man From Utah
programme.desc: One day, John Weston (John Wayne) helps stop a bank robbery. George Higgins (George Hayes), the town's grateful marshal, asks Weston for his help in solving another crime. It seems someone at a touring rodeo show is killing the top riders before they can take home the trophy -- and the prize money. Weston agrees to investigate and works his way into the show, which is run by the shady Spike Barton (Edward Peil). As Weston gets closer to the truth, he finds himself in even greater danger.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: The Silencer

programme.title: Outlaws of the Plains
programme.desc: An impressionable cowpoke, Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), hears a voice claiming to be that of an old Native American, telling him the location of some hidden gold. Fuzzy does find gold, but the land has already been claimed by Nord Finner (Charles King Jr.). Finner offers to sell his claim, and Fuzzy is eager to buy. Then Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe), a friend of Fuzzy's, shows up and discovers that a gang of outlaws is behind a scheme to rob everyone in the area.

programme.title: Pioneer Justice
programme.desc: Something strange is going on in the frontier town of Buffalo Gap. After two men turn up dead, a marshal named Cheyenne (Al "Lash" La Rue) arrives, along with his partner, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), to investigate. Although the outlaw Bill Judd (Jack Ingram) seems to be behind the deaths, the sheriff is not taking any action. When Cheyenne learns the sheriff may be taking orders from another party, he and Fuzzy try to find out who is controlling the criminal element.

programme.title: Romance of the West
programme.desc: Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), along with his sidekick, Ezra (Emmett Lynn), oversees the peaceful coexistence of the Native American tribes with the white settlers of Antelope Valley. The treaty that binds the two groups is threatened when some of the town leaders learn that the Native American land contains rich deposits of silver. Eager to oust the tribes and claim the silver, the town leaders try to provoke an attack that would break the treaty. It's up to Eddie to stop them in time.

programme.title: The Tioga Kid
programme.desc: With assistance from partner Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), Texas Ranger Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) helps rancher Jenny Morgan (Jennifer Holt) recover her stolen herd. Things get even dicier when wanted posters depict a man who looks exactly like Eddie, causing some to believe that he's actually the bad guy.

programme.title: The Dawn Rider

programme.title: Premium
programme.desc: Reginald "Cool" Coolidge is an actor hoping for his big break away from stereotypical black roles. When his ex-fiancée, Charli, pulls in to the gas station where he works, Cool realizes that he still loves her after three years apart. But there is one problem: Charli's wedding to another man is only 36 hours away. Desperate to win her back, Cool uses his talents as an actor to convince Charli that she is choosing the wrong man.

programme.title: Fighting Man of the Plains
programme.desc: Gunslinger and former Confederate Jim Dancer (Randolph Scott) is on a mission to find his brother's killer but mistakenly shoots the wrong man, leading him to become an outlaw. Later, Dancer takes on the identity of a deceased marshal and comes into conflict with a ruthless band of criminals but receives help from a renowned old war buddy. Dancer also finally gets a chance to face off against his sibling's real murderer, Bert Slocum (Barry Kelley), in a tense showdown.

programme.title: The Satan Bug
programme.desc: Special Agent Lee Barrett (George Maharis) joins forces with Ann Williams (Anne Francis), a general's daughter, to recover a biological weapon stolen from a secret government lab. Learning that the pathogen could destroy all life on Earth, they focus their attention on a mysterious millionaire who may have orchestrated the theft. After annihilating a small town in Florida, the villain turns his attention to Los Angeles -- and the duo must race to stop the city's destruction.

programme.title: Attack!
programme.desc: Lt. Joe Costa (Jack Palance) is a part of Fragile Fox Company, a National Guard unit sent to a Belgian town in the final stages of World War II. Costa harbors some serious doubts about the leadership abilities of Captain Cooney (Eddie Albert), a coward who only secured his position because of his ties to Lt. Col. Bartlett (Lee Marvin). Cooney's inexperience and his open contempt for Costa threaten the lives of his men as they draw closer to Battle of the Bulge.

programme.title: Nightmare
programme.desc: Stan Grayson (Kevin McCarthy) dreams that he stabs an unknown man to death, but when he awakens, he is disturbed to find that he has bruises that he doesn't remember getting and a key in his room that doesn't belong to him. Confused, Stan explains his situation to his police officer brother-in-law, Rene (Edward G. Robinson), who initially believes that Stan is simply suffering from anxiety. As the evidence continues to mount, however, it seems to point to something more sinister.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Spiders
programme.desc: Arizona farmer Walter Colby (Woody Strode) and his wife, Birch (Altovise Davis), have a problem on their hands: One of their cows was just killed by a creature, but they have no idea what the beast could have been. So they consult local vet Dr. Robert Hansen (William Shatner), who becomes puzzled and calls in scientist Diane Ashley (Tiffany Bolling). Eventually, the duo discovers that oversize spiders are invading the small town, putting the entire population in danger as a county fair begins.

programme.title: Invisible Invaders
programme.desc: When Dr. Karol Noymann (John Carradine) is killed in an explosion, aliens inhabit his corpse and use it to communicate with his former colleague, Dr. Adam Penner (Philip Tonge), revealing to him that invisible aliens live on the moon. As part of their crew, they hire small-time hustler Arthur Simon Simpson (Peter Ustinov) to act as their fall guy. When the Turkish secret police capture Simpson at the border, they persuade him to spy on his partners in crime, mistakenly believing that they're Communist agents plotting an assassination.

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: Coming home at the end of World War I, Matt Brady (John Payne), the black-sheep brother of big-city political boss Tim Brady (Roy Roberts), is a loose cannon who gets into drunken fights and impulsively marries a total stranger, the plain but kind-hearted Lorry (Gloria McGhee). Taking over his brother's political machine after Tim's sudden death, Matt becomes powerful and extremely wealthy, but his corrupt dealings with a local gangster (Robin Morse) threaten to destroy everything he has.

programme.title: Cloudburst
programme.desc: Canadian World War II veteran John Graham (Robert Preston) works in London as a code breaker. Tragedy strikes when his pregnant wife, Carol (Elizabeth Sellars), is accidentally run over by two crooks who are speeding away from the scene of a murder. Haunted, grieving and thirsting for revenge, Graham sets out to find the two fugitive murderers. When he does, he intends to kill them, the same way they killed Carol. But will that assuage his grief?

programme.title: Hell Bound
programme.desc: A gangster's consort (June Blair) and an ambulance driver (Stuart Whitman) become involved in a villain's (John Russell) plan to steal surplus war drugs.

programme.title: Crime Against Joe
programme.desc: Joe, an unemployed artist living with his mother, is suspected of murdering bar singer Irene Crescent during a drinking binge. His alibi -- that he ran into a sleepwalker and helped her home -- is denied by the sleepwalker's father. A friend, waitress Slacks, who is secretly in love with him, comes to his aid with a false alibi. When it doesn't hold up, Joe and Slacks must go in search of the real killer themselves.

programme.title: Chicago Confidential
programme.desc: A state's attorney (Brian Keith) nails a union leader (Dick Foran) for murder, then learns it was part of a mob frame-up.

programme.title: Portrait in Terror
programme.desc: An English killer (Patrick Magee) and a weird artist (William Campbell) plot to steal a painting in Venice, Calif.

programme.title: Scissors
programme.desc: In the wake of a brutal assault suffered at the hands of a red-bearded stranger, Angie Anderson (Sharon Stone) is grappling with her own sanity. To heal her scarred psyche, her therapist (Ronny Cox) urges hypnotherapy, which causes her to face gruesome truths from her past. Not long after getting entangled in a sordid love triangle with twin brothers, Alex (Steve Railsback) and Cole (also Railsback), Angie is lured into a twisted trap that threatens to unravel what little sanity she has left.

programme.title: Attack on the Iron Coast
programme.desc: With D-Day fast approaching, the Allied forces of World War II prepare to strike a number of strategic Nazi bases. Leading one such attack, Maj. Jamie Wilson (Lloyd Bridges) concocts a risky plan for what is quickly becoming a suicide mission. With a reckless streak that has cost the lives of many men, Wilson faces the opposition of Capt. Owen Franklin (Andrew Keir), whose son was killed in Wilson's last mission. However, Franklin must put aside his feelings when he is ordered to join the major.

programme.title: Hawaii
programme.desc: During the 1820s, a domineering young minister, Abner Hale (Max von Sydow), and his compassionate wife, Jerusha (Julie Andrews), embark on a dangerous sea voyage to Hawaii. When they arrive, Jerusha befriends the Hawaiian people and embraces their customs and culture, while Abner, intent on converting them to Christianity, views them as pagan savages. Jerusha grows unhappy with her marriage and begins to fall for Rafer Hoxworth (Richard Harris), a past lover.

programme.title: The Honey Pot
programme.desc: As an elaborate joke, the wealthy Cecil Fox (Rex Harrison) hires actor William McFly (Cliff Robertson) to play his personal assistant and invites three of his old flames, including Texan socialite Mrs. Lone-Star Crockett Sheridan (Susan Hayward), to visit him. Claiming to be on his deathbed, Fox has motives that remain unclear, and things take a surprising turn when one of the guests is found dead. As Inspector Rizzi (Adolfo Celi) investigates the crime, the plot of the mystery thickens.

programme.title: The Premature Burial
programme.desc: Based on Edgar Allan Poe's story about a cataleptic Englishman obsessed with the fear of being buried alive.

programme.title: The Sharkfighters

But his impatient desire to finish the project quickly conflicts with the researchers' methodical precision, with potentially deadly results.

William Edwards (Richard Widmark) has been assigned to defend the major in his court-martial, but it's not an easy case for the colonel. More than a dozen witnesses are prepared to testify against Cargill, and the major himself admits his guilt. But Edwards begins to suspect that the major is innocent and covering up for someone else.

programme.title: The Pride and the Passion
programme.desc: During the Napoleonic Wars, retreating Spanish forces shove a powerful cannon off a cliff to prevent the French from stealing it. The British send Capt. As Turnbull and the rebel leader Miguel (Frank Sinatra) struggle to transport the cumbersome cannon through the mountains, the British officer falls for beautiful Spaniard Juana (Sophia Loren).

programme.title: Alexander the Great
programme.desc: The son of Philip of Macedonia (Fredric March) and Olympias (Danielle Darrieux), Alexander the Great (Richard Burton) is one of the most legendary leaders throughout history. programme.title: A Story of David: The Hunted
programme.desc: Renowned for his courageous deeds as a youth when he slew Goliath, David (Jeff Chandler) inadvertently incurs the wrath of King Saul (Basil Sydney), who is jealous of the hero's popularity. programme.title: The Sharkfighters
programme.desc: Navy pilot Ben Staves (Victor Mature) arrives at a research facility on a small Caribbean island to help develop a shark repellent for use by sailors and downed airmen. Partnered with scientists Leonard Evans (Philip Coolidge) and Harold Duncan (James Olson), Staves provides valuable information about his own time stranded in the ocean. But his impatient desire to finish the project quickly conflicts with the researchers' methodical precision, with potentially deadly results.

programme.title: Time Limit
programme.desc: Maj. Cargill (Richard Basehart) is accused of aiding his captors while held in a North Korean prison during the war and brought up on charges of treason. Col. William Edwards (Richard Widmark) has been assigned to defend the major in his court-martial, but it's not an easy case for the colonel. More than a dozen witnesses are prepared to testify against Cargill, and the major himself admits his guilt. But Edwards begins to suspect that the major is innocent and covering up for someone else.

programme.title: The Pride and the Passion
programme.desc: During the Napoleonic Wars, retreating Spanish forces shove a powerful cannon off a cliff to prevent the French from stealing it. The British send Capt. As Turnbull and the rebel leader Miguel (Frank Sinatra) struggle to transport the cumbersome cannon through the mountains, the British officer falls for beautiful Spaniard Juana (Sophia Loren).

programme.title: Violent Playground
programme.desc: Sgt. Truman (Stanley Baker), a policeman who deals with juvenile delinquents, visits the Murphy household after a theft by the young twins, Mary and Patrick. There he meets their older sister, Cathie (Anne Heywood), and soon begins a romantic involvement with her. However, Cathie's brother, Johnnie (David McCallum), is the leader of an infamous local gang, and doesn't like to see his sister with a cop. Gradually, Truman starts to see a link between Johnnie and a string of local arsons.

programme.title: The 7th Dawn
programme.desc: After World War II, Ferris (William Holden) remains in Malaya and becomes a successful businessman. He enjoys a quiet existence with his Malayan girlfriend, Dhana (Capucine), although a politician's daughter named Candace (Susannah York) also fancies him. Soon, Ferris encounters a man named Ng (Tetsuro Tamba), who served with him during the war and is now a communist committed to revolution for the guerillas. After Dhana is arrested, Ferris makes a deal to track down Ng in order to save her.

programme.title: Shake Hands With the Devil
programme.desc: In 1921, Kerry O'Shea (Don Murray), an American medical student living in Ireland, learns that his esteemed professor, Sean Lenihan (James Cagney), is also a leader in Ireland's rebel army. Even though Kerry's father and roommate have both been killed by British troops, he refuses to join the Irish rebellion. However, after Kerry is unjustly imprisoned and tortured by the British "Black and Tans" special forces, he fully commits himself to the cause of Irish freedom.

programme.title: Killer's Kiss
programme.desc: Davey Gordon (Jamie Smith), a New York City boxer aging out of his profession, meets dancer Gloria Price (Irene Kane), and they begin a romance. However, their budding relationship is interrupted by Gloria's violent boss, Vincent Rapallo (Frank Silvera), who has eyes for his employee. The two decide to skip town, but before they can, Vincent and his thugs abduct Gloria, and Davey is forced to search for her among the most squalid corners of the city, with his enemy hiding in the shadows.

programme.title: Cop Hater
programme.desc: During a blisteringly hot summer, tensions on the city streets are already high when a cop is inexplicably gunned down, with no leads to go on. programme.title: The Square Peg

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Growing up on the tough streets of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) has his life made even harder by John McKinney (Art Lund), a crooked cop who breaks the boy's leg, crippling him for life. Drawing on his anger at the racism he faces on a daily basis, Tommy grows up to become the crime kingpin of Harlem. Now that he has the power, he aims to take down New York's Mafia bosses -- and also get bloody revenge on his nemesis, McKinney, no matter what the cost.

programme.title: Hammer
programme.desc: Hotheaded laborer B.J. Hammer (Fred Williamson) can't go long without ending up in a fight, and, after he comes out on top in a particularly impressive workplace scuffle, word of his brawling skills makes its way to Davis (Bernie Hamilton), a top boxing manager. Hammer is hired by Davis and begins a lucrative career in the ring, only to find out that his new employer wants him to throw a fight and take part in other illicit activities. Hammer reacts to this news violently, and the feud is on.

programme.title: Bucktown, U.S.A.
programme.desc: After his brother's death, Duke Johnson (Fred Williamson) travels to a small Southern town to organize his brother's funeral. Duke and his friend Aretha (Pam Grier) face demands for bribes and violence from the police. With the arrival of Duke's pal Roy (Thalmus Rasulala), the situation only escalates.

programme.title: Soda Cracker

programme.title: Hell up in Harlem
programme.desc: In Harlem, N.Y., crime boss Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) is gravely injured while escaping a hit ordered by the corrupt district attorney, D'Angelo (Gerald Gordon). As he recovers, his father, Papa Gibbs (Julius W. Harris), assumes control of the gang, which angers Tommy's best henchman, Zach (Tony King), who goes on to collaborate with D'Angelo and frame Papa Gibbs for the murder of Tommy's ex-wife. This sets off a series of bloody betrayals that ricochet within the crime world.

programme.title: J.D.'s Revenge
programme.desc: Although notorious New Orleans gangster J.D. Walker (David McKnight) is shot and killed in the 1940s, his spirit remains restless for three decades, until a hypnotist's supernatural nightclub act allows him to take over the body of Isaac (Glynn Turman), a mild-mannered law student. After inhabiting Isaac, Walker decides to hunt down the Rev. Elija Bliss (Louis Gossett Jr.), a former criminal who helped the authorities find and assassinate the mobster years ago.

programme.title: Sugar Hill
programme.desc: When nightclub owner Langston (Larry D. Johnson) refuses to sell out to local mob boss Morgan (Robert Quarry), he is beaten to death by a gang of hired thugs. His grief-stricken fiancée, Diana "Sugar" Hill (Marki Bey), vows revenge for his murder and turns to aged voodoo authority Mama Maitresse (Zara Cully). Together they conjure up the demonic spirit of Baron Samedi (Don Pedro Colley), who agrees to help Sugar. He raises an army of zombies and sets them upon Langston's killers.

programme.title: Blacula
programme.desc: During a visit to Transylvania, an African prince (William Marshall) gets turned into a vampire by Count Dracula (Charles Macaulay). Sealed in a coffin for several lifetimes, "Blacula" reawakens in the 1970s Los Angeles. Leaving a trail of bloodless victims in his wake, he pursues Lina (Vonetta McGee), a woman who bears a striking resemblance to his dead wife. Meanwhile, Dr. Gordon Thomas (Thalmus Rasulala) and top cop Lt. Peters (Gordon Pinsent) are hot on the bloodsucker's trail.

programme.title: Scream Blacula Scream
programme.desc: When a hated rival, Lisa Fortier (Pam Grier), is chosen to lead the voodoo cult of Willis Daniels' (Richard Lawson) late mother, a vengeful Willis brings the doomed vampire Prince Mamuwalde (William Marshall) back to life. Willis soon finds the vampire too powerful to control, and Lisa agrees to perform a spell that will break the curse placed on the prince. But, when racist sheriff Dunlop (Michael Conrad) gets involved, the vampire unleashes his deadly revenge.

programme.title: Cotton Comes to Harlem
programme.desc: Harlem's African-American population is being ripped off by the Rev. Deke O'Malley (Calvin Lockhart), who dishonestly claims that small donations will secure parcels of land in Africa. When New York City police officers Gravedigger Jones (Godfrey Cambridge) and Coffin Ed Johnson (Raymond St. Jacques) look into O'Malley's scam, they learn that the cash is being smuggled inside a bale of cotton. But the police, O'Malley and lots of others find themselves scrambling when the money goes missing.

programme.title: Blind Rage
programme.desc: A CIA agent (Fred Williamson) in a pancake house closes the case of five blind bank robbers in the Philippines.

programme.title: Article 99
programme.desc: Dr. Richard Sturgess (Ray Liotta) leads a team of compassionate doctors at a veteran's hospital. Along with Drs. Morgan (Kiefer Sutherland), Handleman (Forest Whitaker) and Van Dorn (Lea Thompson), he fights to deliver adequate care to needy veterans in the face of funding cuts and a corrupt administration. To succeed, the staff may have to bend the rules and circumvent the villainous "Article 99," a bureaucratic loophole that prevents veterans from receiving the benefits they deserve.

When Tinseltown Studios casts Taylor in the title role, he has a series of conflicted dreams satirizing African-American stereotypes in Hollywood, and must reconcile his career goals with his desire to remain a positive role model for his little brother (Craigus R Johnson).

programme.title: Cotton Comes to Harlem
programme.desc: Harlem's African-American population is being ripped off by the Rev. Deke O'Malley (Calvin Lockhart), who dishonestly claims that small donations will secure parcels of land in Africa. When New York City police officers Gravedigger Jones (Godfrey Cambridge) and Coffin Ed Johnson (Raymond St. Jacques) look into O'Malley's scam, they learn that the cash is being smuggled inside a bale of cotton. But the police, O'Malley and lots of others find themselves scrambling when the money goes missing.

programme.title: Blind Rage
programme.desc: A CIA agent (Fred Williamson) in a pancake house closes the case of five blind bank robbers in the Philippines.

programme.title: Article 99
programme.desc: Dr. Richard Sturgess (Ray Liotta) leads a team of compassionate doctors at a veteran's hospital. Along with Drs. To succeed, the staff may have to bend the rules and circumvent the villainous "Article 99," a bureaucratic loophole that prevents veterans from receiving the benefits they deserve.

programme.title: Barbarosa
programme.desc: In pre-Civil War Texas, naïve Karl Westover (Gary Busey) accidentally kills his brother-in-law, and heads to Mexico to escape the consequences. Along the way, he encounters Barbarosa (Willie Nelson), who is also on the run. Barbarosa teaches Karl survival skills for the desert -- and how to rob. In their journey from Texas to Mexico and back again, the two men are captured by outlaw Angel Morales, and pursued by Don Braulito (Gilbert Roland), who wants Barbarosa dead.
