programme.title: The Undefeated
programme.desc: Unaware that the Civil War has ended, Col. John Henry Thomas (John Wayne) successfully attacks a Confederate company led by James Langdon (Rock Hudson). With the remnants of Langdon's squadron fleeing to Mexico, Thomas and his adopted Native American son, Blue Boy (Roman Gabriel), gather a herd of horses and head for the border with their company, to sell them. After Langdon's caravan is captured by a Mexican general (Tony Aguilar), Thomas nobly sacrifices the horses to free them.

programme.title: A Reason to Live, A Reason to Die
programme.desc: After surrendering Fort Holman to the Confederacy without there being a single shot fired, Col. Pembroke (James Coburn) faces public disgrace and a potential court-martial unless he's able to recapture the fort now held by the power-mad Maj. Ward (Telly Savalas). To help him on this mission, Pembroke enlists a ragtag bunch of condemned men who are promised their freedom should they survive. Despite much internal strife, the group gradually comes together in time for the assault.

programme.title: It's a Mann's World
programme.desc: Multitalented entertainers David and Tamela Mann are known mostly for their stage and screen collaborations with producer Tyler Perry ("Meet the Browns"). "It's a Mann's World" provides fans a view of the couple behind the camera -- at home, attending exclusive events, and spending time with famous friends. The hourlong episodes show how David and Tamela balance being celebrities, entrepreneurs and parents to four adult children while maintaining their marriage of 20-plus years.

programme.title: Live: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to "SportsCenter" viewers. programme.title: Live: The Leadoff Spot
programme.desc: Co-hosted by a combination of veteran baseball analysts - Steve Phillips, Xavier Scruggs and Eduardo Pérez - the program will deliver expert commentary, plus interviews with baseball newsmakers and club personnel.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati meets chef and historian Maru Toledo who is working to preserve and pass on some of Jalisco's most important regional recipes. Pati makes Jalisco-style chicken tamales and chile relleno rice dressed with salsa roja.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Gualberto "Weber" Elizondo surprised his family when his grilling hobby turned him into a local celebrity and internet sensation. Meanwhile, chef Chuy Villareal of Cara De Vaca wants the world to know that the north of Mexico isn't just carne asada.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati is in one of Mexico's most popular beach destinations - Puerto Vallarta. She gets an insider's tour of the best street food from one of the town's most acclaimed chefs, Thierry Boulet.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati visits the birthplace of Mexico's most famous spirit, the town of Tequila. Back home Pati makes a brunch of corn tortilla egg nests with salsa verde con chile de árbol and traditional arroz rojo.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati experiences the Escaramuza — An all-female horse riding and skills competition. In the kitchen, Pati makes Jalisco-style birria and her friend, pastry chef and cookbook author Fany Gerson, joins her to make gelatinas for dessert.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.sub-title: An Underground Pit of Cochinita Pibil
programme.desc: Pati visits Chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halachó to prepare a traditional Cochinita Pibil in an underground pit. Pati helps Wilson prepare the achiote marinade, along with his grandmother who taught him traditional cooking.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati meets the young chefs behind one of Guadalajara's most exciting restaurants, Xokol. Back home, Pati invites her friend Francisco Migoya over to make conchas to go with pellizcadas with chicharrón in salsa verde.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.sub-title: A Mayan League of their Own
programme.desc: In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: Pat Martin travels to Decatur, Alabama to visit a storied institution of barbecue - Big Bob Gibson's. There, he learns the ins, the outs, and the history of a regional delicacy: pit-cooked chicken with Alabama white sauce.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.sub-title: Discovering Indian Lamb Kebabs in Nashville
programme.desc: Pat grills riverside with renowned chef Vivek Surti, crafting lamb kofta and chicken kebabs inspired by his Indian heritage.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati experiences the Escaramuza — An all-female horse riding and skills competition. In the kitchen, Pati makes Jalisco-style birria and her friend, pastry chef and cookbook author Fany Gerson, joins her to make gelatinas for dessert.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: In the Salinas Valley of California, young Tom Tiflin lives on his family's ranch with his parents, Fred and Alice, who are constantly at odds, and with his rambling grandfather. Capturing Tom's admiration, however, is the hired ranch hand, Billy Buck, a venerable horse expert. When his father gives him a pony as a gift, Tom learns the importance of responsibility, but also has to face the pain of loss.

programme.title: Mr. Blandings Builds His Dream House
programme.desc: When advertising executive Jim Blandings discovers his wife's plan to redecorate their New York apartment, he counters with a proposal that they move to Connecticut. She agrees, and the two are soon conned into buying a house that turns out to be a complete nightmare. Construction and repair bills accumulate quickly, and Jim worries that their future hangs in the balance unless he can come up with a catchy new jingle that will sell ham.

programme.title: The Bachelor and the Bobby-Soxer
programme.desc: Artist playboy Dickie Nugent (Cary Grant) appears before beautiful judge Margaret Turner (Myrna Loy) for fighting at a nightclub, and charms her into dismissing the charge. That same day, Dickie happens to lecture at a high school, where Margaret's teenage sister, Susan (Shirley Temple), falls head-over-heels for him. Things get complicated when Susan sneaks away and is found in Dickie's apartment, and downright zany when he is court ordered to date the teen as a way of easing her attraction.

programme.title: Third Finger, Left Hand
programme.desc: Uninterested in an office romance, successful fashion journalist Margot Sherwood Merrick (Myrna Loy) goes to great lengths to conceal the fact that she's single. To ward off potential beaus, including painter Jeff Thompson (Melvyn Douglas), she wears a fake wedding ring and tells everyone she already has a husband. When Jeff realizes that Margot doesn't have a spouse, he decides to make her pay for her deception by posing as her husband, leading to a comical rivalry and a surprising romance.

programme.title: So Goes My Love
programme.desc: Eccentric British inventor Hiram Maxim (Don Ameche) and his bride (Myrna Loy) raise a son (Bobby Driscoll) in late-1800s Brooklyn.

programme.title: A Successful Calamity
programme.desc: After a year away in Europe, successful financier Henry Wilton (George Arliss) is finally returning home to his wife, Emmy (Mary Astor), daughter Peggy (Evalyn Knapp) and son Eddie, only to discover their lifestyle leaves them much too busy to spend any time together as a family. In a ploy to keep everyone together, Wilton lies about his wealth and announces he's financially ruined. As expected, his family rallies to support his supposed losses, but how long can he keep the charade up?

programme.title: Turn Back the Clock
programme.desc: A cigar-store keeper (Lee Tracy) dreams of what his life would have been like with power, prestige and a rich wife.

programme.title: The Millionaire
programme.desc: Growing bored with life as a retiree, millionaire James Alden (George Arliss) secretly invests in an unprofitable gas station to amuse himself. Disguising himself and using the alias "Charles Miller," James begins a partnership with a young bootstrapper named Bill Merrick (David Manners). Complications arise when James' spoiled daughter, Barbara (Evalyn Knapp), becomes a regular customer and competition from a neighboring gas station threatens to ruin the business.

programme.title: Tycoon
programme.desc: American engineer Johnny Munroe (John Wayne) is hired by South American tycoon Frederick Alexander (Cedric Hardwicke) to bore a tunnel for a new railroad in the Andes Mountains. On the job, he falls for Alexander's beautiful daughter, Maura (Laraine Day). Facing dangerous conditions and serious design challenges, Munroe struggles to complete the job he was hired to do, while simultaneously struggling to convince his skeptical, overprotective employer that he is a worthy suitor for Maura.

programme.title: Silver Dollar
programme.desc: Yates Martin (Edward G. Robinson) and his wife, Sarah (Aline MacMahon), are struggling to make ends meet as owners of a grocery store in late 19th-century Colorado. When Martin's silver mine strikes it rich, he begins to live the high life, moving to a huge mansion and running for public office. His grandiose ways alienate his wife, however, so he takes up with Lily (Bebe Daniels). Then Martin begins dreaming of running for national office, unaware that his fate will change once again.

programme.title: The World Changes
programme.desc: A young Midwesterner (Paul Muni) becomes a meat tycoon with a socialite wife (Mary Astor).

programme.title: Boom Town
programme.desc: Two rogue Texas oil men, Big John McMasters (Clark Gable) and Square John Sand (Spencer Tracy), drill oil wells in fields where there is no known oil. These wildcatters team up with a local drilling equipment owner, Luther Aldrich (Frank Morgan), and strike it rich -- but the ups and downs of the oil business, the whims of South American politics, and the love of Elizabeth Betsy Bartlett (Claudette Colbert) threaten to tear the two friends apart.

programme.title: The Enchanted Cottage
programme.desc: Disfigured from wounds suffered in war, pilot Oliver Bradford (Robert Young) runs away in shame from his beautiful fiancée (Hillary Brooke) and his mother (Spring Byington). Renting a cottage from the kind-hearted Mrs. Minnett (Mildred Natwick), Oliver meets the plain-looking but gentle housekeeper Laura Pennington (Dorothy McGuire). As the veteran and the maid begin to learn more about one another, they see past their outer imperfections to discover that true beauty lies within.

programme.title: Desire Me
programme.desc: Soldiers Paul Aubert and Jean Renaud attempt to make their escape from a Nazi prison camp, but only Jean makes it out alive. When Jean is dispatched to deliver the sad news to Paul's wife, Marise, he begins a budding romance with the recently widowed woman. Then Paul, injured but still very much alive, sends word that he is coming to reunite with his wife, putting a damper on Jean's plans to start a new life with Marise.

programme.title: The Great Lie
programme.desc: After her long-time boyfriend, pilot Pete Van Allen (George Brent), marries fiery concert pianist Sandra Kovak (Mary Astor) while drunk, Maggie Patterson (Bette Davis) is heartbroken. Pete learns the marriage is illegal, yet dutifully offers to remarry Sandra. But when she refuses to alter a performance date to do so, Pete returns to Maggie and marries her. Soon after, Pete goes missing on a flight -- and when Maggie learns Sandra is carrying Pete's baby, she makes the pianist a shocking offer.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Paranormal researcher Abby Yates and physicist Erin Gilbert are trying to prove that ghosts exist in modern society. When strange apparitions appear in Manhattan, Gilbert and Yates turn to engineer Jillian Holtzmann for help. Also joining the team is Patty Tolan, a lifelong New Yorker who knows the city inside and out. Armed with proton packs and plenty of attitude, the four women prepare for an epic battle as more than 1,000 mischievous ghouls descend on Times Square.

They're rescued, however, and plot their revenge.

programme.title: The Verdict With Judge Hatchett
programme.desc: Judge Glenda Hatchett presided over her self-titled courtroom show from 2000-2008. Now, she returns to the medium with "The Verdict." In the half-hour series, the Atlanta native and former juvenile-court judge rules over small-claims cases brought in front of her. Hatchett's courtroom isn't just about finding someone guilty, though. She also uses her experience dealing with young people and her tough-love approach to help send a message to out-of-control juvenile offenders to try to set them on the right track in their lives.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: Casos de familia
programme.desc: Personas comunes y corrientes se reúnen en el escenario para exponer sus historias reales y dramas personales, ellos comentan sus casos ante la audiencia presente y ante el público televidente. La anfitriona del programa se encarga de conducir a los panelistas para exponer sus casos en forma clara, sacar una conclusión al problema y tratar de solucionarlo, gracias a su carisma y habilidad para conectarse con sus invitados de una manera positiva con sus análisis objetivos, ella, por lo general encuentra la solución a los conflictos. Los temas tratados son diversos, incluyendo conflictos familiares, problemas entre socios, infidelidad, paternidad, entre otros.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: Casos de familia
programme.desc: Personas comunes y corrientes se reúnen en el escenario para exponer sus historias reales y dramas personales, ellos comentan sus casos ante la audiencia presente y ante el público televidente. La anfitriona del programa se encarga de conducir a los panelistas para exponer sus casos en forma clara, sacar una conclusión al problema y tratar de solucionarlo, gracias a su carisma y habilidad para conectarse con sus invitados de una manera positiva con sus análisis objetivos, ella, por lo general encuentra la solución a los conflictos. Los temas tratados son diversos, incluyendo conflictos familiares, problemas entre socios, infidelidad, paternidad, entre otros.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

programme.title: Sábados felices
programme.desc: El legendario programa televisivo más reconocido, aclamado y querido por los colombianos, que ya hace parte de la cultura del país y que ha divertido y entretenido a varias generaciones, presenta en sus segmentos característicos, una gama variada de estilos de comedia, cuenta chistes, parodias originales, caracterizaciones de importantes personalidades del país y personalidades internacionales, cuenteros y troveros. Esta serie creada por su anfitrión Alfonso Lizarazo, le ha dado la oportunidad a talentos desconocidos de llegar al estrellato, este espacio ha sido una plataforma para los que han sido aclamados como los mejores comediantes del país. El programa además apoya obras sociales y ha ayudado a recaudar recursos monetarios que han contribuido a construir muchos centros estudiantiles.

programme.title: La ruleta de la suerte
programme.desc: Una de las versiones españolas del programa de concurso clásico norteamericano de gran acogida que se inició en los años setenta, titulado "Wheel of Fortune" o la "Ruleta de la fortuna" en español. Este formato se ha realizado en más de 25 países y se ha extendido al público internacional. Los concursantes deben adivinar oraciones sobre temas variados, llenando los vacíos con letras adivinadas que ellos enuncian, el que adivine una letra perteneciente a la frase gana un premio monetario y el premio se incrementa si adivina la frase completa. Se realizan varias rondas, en la que se incrementa la dificultad y la complejidad de los temas que se abordan.

Este formato se ha realizado en más de 25 países y se ha extendido al público internacional. Los concursantes deben adivinar oraciones sobre temas variados, llenando los vacíos con letras adivinadas que ellos enuncian, el que adivine una letra perteneciente a la frase gana un premio monetario y el premio se incrementa si adivina la frase completa. Se realizan varias rondas, en la que se incrementa la dificultad y la complejidad de los temas que se abordan.

programme.title: Dinastías
programme.desc: David Attenborough sigue a cinco animales en peligro de extinción, cada uno de los cuales lucha por sobrevivir contra sus rivales y las fuerzas de la naturaleza.

programme.title: Tu planeta
programme.desc: Un viaje inolvidable, una visita a los lugares más espectaculares del mundo.

programme.title: Planeta helado
programme.desc: El equipo que produjo la serie ganadora del premio Emmy, "Planet Earth" de la Unidad de Historia Natural de la BBC y de Discovery Channel combinan sus esfuerzos una vez más para crear este documental magnífico de siete partes. Grabado en su totalidad en alta definición e incluye cinematografía con tecnología de punta, para capturar el comportamiento de los animales sin ser disturbados, este programa hace una crónica de los ecosistemas y de los animales del Ártico y el Antártico, lugares en el que los cineastas pasaron 2.300 días y en el océano 18 meses para grabar cortos sin precedentes. Los episodios siguen las vidas de los osos polares, los lobos, las ballenas asesinas y los pingüinos, desde la primavera hasta el invierno y además hay un episodio que detalla los desafíos enfrentados por el equipo que realizó el documental. La serie es narrada por Alec Baldwin y el séptimo episodio incluye una visión sobre los efectos del calentamiento global en los polos y el resto.

La serie se transmite en tres ediciones nocturnas, luego se re-transmite la última edición cuatro veces cada mañana de lunes a viernes antes de despejar el escenario para un bloque de seis horas de "SportsCenter" en vivo, que pone más énfasis en la interactividad de los fanáticos, noticias, análisis, comentarios y la cobertura de las conferencias de prensa.

credits.actor: Rajesh Khanna,Shabana Azmi,Madan Puri,Sujit Kumar,A. K. Hangal,Sachin,Gulshan Grover

programme.title: इंटरनेशनल क्रूक

programme.title: मासूम

programme.desc: एक पारिवारिक व्यक्ति का जीवन बदलता है, जब उसे पता चलता है कि उसका एक नाजायज बेटा है। बच्चे की माँ मरणासन्न के दौरान, उसे उसके पिता के साथ रहने के लिए भेजती है।.

programme.desc: प्रकाश को अपने पिता के आकस्मिक मृत्यु के बाद पूरे परिवार की ज़िम्मेदारी का ख्याल रखना होगा। उसका छोटा भाई चंदन लगातार उसके विवाहित जीवन को बर्बाद करने की कोशिश करता है।.

programme.desc: Mampukah Monaco meneruskan tren tanpa kekalahan di Ligue 1 musim ini saat bertandang ke kandang Lorient?

programme.title: 鱷魚河 / Crocodile River
programme.desc: 這個故事洋溢著《羅密歐與茱麗葉》般的悲戀色彩。兩個世代積怨已深的家族，被一條遍佈鱷魚的河流阻隔，誰也不願築橋往來。然而，命運卻讓兩家子女在大學裡邂逅並深深相愛。為了相守，他們不僅必須跨越險惡的河流，更要化解兩個家族間延續多年的仇恨。.

programme.title: 水晶人 / Portrait In Crystal
programme.desc: 故事講述，龍飛精心雕琢的水晶美人像忽然失蹤後，多名黑道高手離奇被殺，江湖傳言乃水晶人變成精靈殺人之所為。龍飛經過連番追蹤後，終發現水晶人乃日後訓練之殺手。水晶人揭發江湖廝殺之真正幕後人，實為偽裝王爺的天帝...

programme.title: 夜生活的女人 / Woman of the Night
programme.desc: 本片由三個內容不同的故事構成。青年喜歡偷窺異性，結果其姐懇求雇主交際花實行肉身布施，驚醒青年迷夢。好色總經理常設計欲打美貌秘書的主意，偷香不到，反被懲戒。好丈夫喪失性能力，不願妻子痛苦，故作暴躁舉動，讓其妻帶著女兒離去，十年後，一家才得以諒解。.

programme.title: 追魂鏢 / Killer Darts
programme.desc: 故事描述青虹大俠劉文龍的徒弟鬍子峰不耐孤寂生活，非禮殺害村婦後逃走。劉收婦遺孤玉蟬為徒，玉蟬長大後與劉子玉郎相愛，但玉蟬偶遇胡，誤信劉是殺母仇人….

programme.title: 警察 / Police Force
programme.desc: 梁觀偕同情侶沈燕，在郊外遊玩談心時，不幸遇上歹徒劫財色，梁護花不成更慘遭毒手。梁之摯友黃國棟報仇心切，遂毅然投身警界，期有機會親自偵緝兇手。五年後，黃因出眾表現被升職之餘，亦與沈日久生情；不久，因一宗離奇的謀殺案件，沈認出當年殺害梁的兇手…….

programme.title: 我們戀愛去了 / Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: 一次偶然機會下，富家子大用巧遇育幼院院長之外甥女連蓮。二人初次見面，雙方即發生誤會，大用更在匆忙間遺下皮包。當大用硬將連蓮假裝成爲自己的未婚妻好讓兩個傾慕他的女子死心時，又與連蓮發生了第二次誤會...

programme.title: 大旗英雄傳 / Clan Feuds
programme.desc: 鐵中棠是大旗門掌門人雲翼的義子。門派宿敵司徒笑為奪取秘藏，追殺鐵中棠與雲翼次子雲錚。鐵中棠得知，唯有前往長春島尋找武功蓋世的「日后」，才能揭開大旗門的秘密。然而抵達後卻發現「日后」早已身亡，反而遇見大旗門創始人「夜帝」鐵毅，並驚覺對方竟是自己的親生父親。.

programme.title: 扭計祖宗陳夢吉 / Two Con Men
programme.desc: 華南影帝張瑛與梁天合作的清末喜劇，二人分飾師爺荒唐鏡及奇人陳夢吉。陳得知荒平素極盡斂財害人之能事，遂喬扮應徵僕人...

programme.title: 卒仔抽車 / Rolls, Rolls, I Love You
programme.desc: 阿旦、墨魚、阿喜、荷官等一群窮小子，遇上生活寂寥的富豪崔東成，達成了一個賭局，要於十日內偷得崔的名車。五人與崔鬥智鬥力，終戰勝億萬富豪！.

programme.title: 阿牛出獄記 / Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: 續集中阿牛不幸的遭遇更令人心痛，當中不少更是笑中有淚的經歷。阿牛出獄後，再遇愛人阿花，可惜她已嫁為人妻；另一方面，戇直的阿牛仍不斷被狡猾的周大叔欺騙...

programme.title: 大刀王五 / Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: 經營鏢局的大刀王五遇上譚嗣同，這位新黨成員致力於改革清末政府。雖然皇帝支持推行新法，但慈禧太后卻無意交出政權，因此她下令捉拿新黨的所有成員。儘管王五並無政治立場，卻無奈地被捲入這場政治漩渦之中。.

programme.title: 我愛金龜婿 / We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: 三個香港美少女何莉莉、陳依齡及淩雲，帶著愛情夢遠赴日本大阪，一心指望釣得如意郎君。豈料三人被誤會是富家千金，結果惹出趣事連篇。.

programme.title: 金臂童 / The Kid with the Golden Arm
programme.desc: 虎威鏢局總鏢頭楊虎雲受官府之託，押运二十萬兩黃金赴黃河流域賬災，武林豪傑「長斧」殷九、「短斧」方十、「冷月劍」冷鳳、「寒星劍」李青冥等紛紛前來助陣。當時「七殺谷」中一批武功高強的劇盜，早就佈署截劫詭計，鏢隊幸得「千面神捕」海濤沿途暗中出手相助，化險為夷...

programme.title: 西廂記 / West Chamber
programme.desc: 張生、崔鶯鶯才子佳人相會，俏紅娘從中牽赤繩；西廂夜訪，私定終身；崔老夫人知情大怒，憤而拷紅；紅娘怨夫人不該言而無信，終成就百年姻緣。.

programme.title: 西廂記 / West Chamber
programme.desc: 張生、崔鶯鶯才子佳人相會，俏紅娘從中牽赤繩；西廂夜訪，私定終身；崔老夫人知情大怒，憤而拷紅；紅娘怨夫人不該言而無信，終成就百年姻緣。.

programme.title: 孔雀王朝 / Murder Plot
programme.desc: 遊俠沈浪與六大門派高手商討對付奸梟歡喜王，正值莊內嚴肅之際，其未婚妻竟無理取鬧，沈只好帶其未婚妻離開。其後，二人繼續追捕歡喜王，但卻意外墮入歡喜王的圈套。.

programme.title: 港澳傳奇 / Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: 澳門古玩店老闆，識破老婆與估衣鋪老闆有染後，威脅胡幫他引誘垂涎已久的王妻；香港賭徒在澳賭場邂逅流黑市夫人，事後恬要求與石同居，結局出人意表...

programme.title: 南斗官三鬥北少爺 / Wits Of The Brats
programme.desc: 廣東大良富家子弟南斗官天資聰穎、武藝高強，卻屢次惹禍生事，母親遂命他上京招親，藉此磨練心性。途中，他結識了精通千術的車載、追女高手真厲害及身懷絕技的神偷時三手，四人不打不相識，隨後攜手對抗圖謀南家家產的三眼道人。.

programme.title: 玉女親情 / A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: 故事講述張愛珠無意得知自己是孤兒，故往找生母。生母茱莉與流氓劉老四同居，老四心起歪念，竟欲非禮愛珠，茱莉救了女兒，卻被老四誤殺。愛珠逃回養父母家，始深深體會到養父母對她的愛。.

programme.title: 藍與黑 / The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: 抗日戰爭期間，少年孤女唐琪愛上青年張醒亞。家庭的壓力與戰爭的動盪令這對有情人飽受煎熬。直至唐琪不幸被強姦，不容於家庭, 而唯有走上夜總會歌女的不歸路...

programme.title: 江湖三女俠 / Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: 故事講述，胸懷野心的朱天翔得知韓氏三姐妹若蘭、如玫、曉蓮家藏威力驚人的玄鐵神劍，若能奪得，必能戰勝「武林之尊」修德武館，稱霸江湖...

programme.title: 武松 / Tiger Killer
programme.desc: 一次醉酒後，武松赤手空拳打死一隻猛虎，因此被任命為都頭。武松兄長武大郎的妻子潘金蓮色誘武松，但遭他拒絕。後來，潘金蓮和富戶西門慶有染，及後姦情敗露，兩人繼而毒死了武大郎。武松知悉後，先殺潘金蓮再殺西門慶，為兄長報仇。.

programme.title: 千門八將 / Notorious Eight
programme.desc: 盡窺賭術內幕的影片《千門八將》講述，正將是道上叱吒風雲的“賭王”。一次，他在與“賭魔”的賭局中，被其暗算而隱恨退出江湖。二十年後，賭魔以計迫使正將重出賭壇，正將被賭魔以千術擊敗，含怨吐血而亡。正將之子為報父仇，邀其請昔日與其父親出生入死的拍檔“千門八將”與賭魔展開連場賭博......

programme.title: 拜倒石榴裙 / Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: 年輕貌美的丁芝華為緩解家中困境，與弟弟策劃了一場珠寶騙局，並打算將贓物帶往新加坡變賣。飛行途中，她為躲避海關查緝，急中生智將鑽戒塞進鄰座乘客張志賢身上，卻在出關後失去他的蹤影。無奈之下，芝華只得施展一連串笨拙又滑稽的計謀，試圖奪回戒指。.

programme.title: 黑蜥蜴 / The Black Lizard
programme.desc: 本片改編自著名武俠小說家黃鷹之同名小說。故事講述，丁鵬與蕭立本是同門師兄弟，而丁妻與蕭妻則是兩姊妹。兩家本極為友好，後來丁妻誕下一子，而蕭妻誕下一女，但蕭獨喜子。丁妻為了成全姐夫心願，便來一個男女對換，惟完成此事後便告死去。蕭妻內心有愧，手抱兒子往見丁，不料為蕭暗中看見，頓生綠帽疑雲，狠然佈下瘋子殺母之計，以加害丁家...

programme.title: 狂戀詩 / Summer Heat
programme.desc: 大偉和小春是同胞兄弟，一個放浪，一個含蓄。小春在舞會邂逅女子珠迪，情心一片。大偉發現珠迪有個年老丈夫，得知此秘密，大偉以此威脅，迫珠迪和他幽會，自始珠迪周旋三個男人之間... 導演以女性角度大膽描寫男女情關，手法細膩，而結局亦出人意表。.

programme.title: 清宮啟示錄 / The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: 清朝兩位太子為要爭奪帝位，令人民死傷無數。被牽連在這場皇室鬥爭當中的女刺客，最終能否及時執行刺殺任務以助其中一位皇子登上皇位？.

programme.title: 佛跳牆 / The Mad Monk (1977)
programme.desc: 故事共有四個單元，講述濟公四出助人的善行，包括幫助一對母女避過倒塌的石牆，助菜販免受惡霸的滋擾，又為年青人尋回被盜的金錢，更以巧計教訓胡作非爲的相爺父子。.

programme.title: 叉手 / Masked Avengers
programme.desc: 「叉手」為江湖上新崛起之組織，專殺江湖豪俠，彼等行事，均帶面具，故彼等究為何人，無人知曉。「八臂哪吒」齊山雲會同曾軍及梁勇等，赴景陽鎮調查叉手總壇之所在，擬一舉殲滅該組織，為江湖除害。三人在客棧見一沉默寡言之伙頭，態度極為神秘，暗忖此人必也是來偵查「叉手」者...

programme.title: 叉手 / Masked Avengers
programme.desc: 「叉手」為江湖上新崛起之組織，專殺江湖豪俠，彼等行事，均帶面具，故彼等究為何人，無人知曉。「八臂哪吒」齊山雲會同曾軍及梁勇等，赴景陽鎮調查叉手總壇之所在，擬一舉殲滅該組織，為江湖除害。三人在客棧見一沉默寡言之伙頭，態度極為神秘，暗忖此人必也是來偵查「叉手」者...

programme.title: 三笑 / The Three Smiles
programme.desc: 風流才子唐伯虎邂逅了丫鬟秋香，被她所吸引，遂決定隱瞞身份，進入華家作書僮，藉此接近秋香，並向她表明自己的身份和來意，可惜秋香並不相信。最後，唐伯虎憑藉其出眾的個人才智及好友的協助下，終於抱得美人歸。.

programme.title: 方世玉與胡惠乾 / The Shaolin Avengers
programme.desc: 武當派敗類白眉道人、馮道德、雷老虎等，勾結清廷，甘受驅使來殘殺武林中人，方世玉之父母方濟亨、苗翠花，胡惠乾之父皆為雷等所殺；胡一次尋仇不遂，為方所救，後隨方往少林寺練就高強武功...影片最後少林與武當之武林自相殘殺的畫面，出現一幕令人怵目驚心的大結局。.

programme.title: 海軍突擊隊 / The Naval Commandos
programme.desc: 故事描述二次大戰日軍侵佔上海，中國海軍力量薄弱，難以跟日艦抗衡；為保存戰力，在長江布下水雷，將一艘魚雷快艇偽裝成漁船，乘夜突襲...

programme.title: 天龍八部 / The Battle Wizard
programme.desc: 大理國王子段譽不懂武功，卻私自離宮闖蕩江湖。途中，段譽先後遇上玩蛇姑娘鍾靈和同父異母的姊姊木婉清。因緣際會下，段譽吸光朱蝮蟒的血和吃下碧血蛤，得到了絕世功力，最終更擊敗父親的多年仇敵黃袍人。.

programme.title: 神劍震江湖 / The Thundering Sword
programme.desc: 余乾文與同門師弟鄭坤元奉師父之命下山尋訪「天地劍」，以免它落入壞人手中造成武林浩劫。余乾文途中巧遇五毒教教主之女蘇皎皎，兩人情投意合。可惜，當蘇皎皎意外地弄傷鄭坤元後，事情也開始變得越來越複雜。.

programme.title: 傾國傾城 / The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: 李翰祥史詩式電影，藝術成就及導演功力震驚中港台三地。本片榮獲金馬優等劇情片、最佳女主角及最佳彩色影片美術設計獎項。影后盧燕飾慈禧太后；處女演出即成名的蕭瑤，飾死後受追封為貴妃的珍妃；而為珍妃逝世而不近女色的光緒帝則是狄龍。.

programme.title: 吉祥賭坊 / The Casino
programme.desc: 一對青梅竹馬的情侶相隔多年後在神秘的吉祥賭坊相遇，二人決意要一起剷除貪污的將軍、罪犯和勒索者！.

programme.title: 老夫子 / Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: 與老夫子一起經歷連串的漫畫故事，看他和他傻頭傻腦的好友大番薯如何為抱得美人歸而弄至笑話連篇！.

programme.title: 八道樓子 / 7-Man Army
programme.desc: 1933年長城戰役爆發，日軍出動數萬兵力及坦克進攻古北口。混戰中，中國軍隊主力撤退，七名與部隊失散的士兵被困於「八道樓子」戰略碉堡。他們面對日軍重重圍攻，浴血奮戰，誓死堅守陣地，譜寫了一段悲壯的抗戰史詩。.

programme.title: 遺產五億圓 / The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: 故事講述三女意外獲得大筆財產，必須遠赴日本領取，途中遇上三位男人，也想分一杯羹。正當大家各懷鬼胎，彼此攻擊、賄賂甚至出賣對方，企圖獨佔鉅款時，殊不知更驚悚的遭遇正嚴陣以待。.

programme.title: 小子有種 / My Rebellious Son
programme.desc: 貪官為討好一群西方人，設計攫取鎮中廟宇的寶貴佛像。幸得張德泰醫師及其兒子張小泰二人合力利用中國功夫，先破西洋拳，再敗日本劍道，然後大勝西洋劍，最終才可保住佛像。.

programme.title: 七十二家房客 / The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: 七十二家房客租住一幢舊式的庭院，終日受潑辣的女房東和她卑鄙的丈夫的欺壓。一名勇於發聲的新房客出現，改變了租客的命運。他們合力對抗逼遷、抵制貪警，最終成功不讓房東出售家園。.

programme.title: 玉面俠 / The Jade Faced Assassin
programme.desc: 章臻與月奴相愛卻不被接納，二人被四怪所殺後，留下一對雙胞兒。月奴的姊姊希望挽救其門派的聲望，拆散雙胞，將他們分別送到對立門派收養。十八年後，雙胞胎兒重聚，互相傷殘，亦隨即掀起江湖風風雨雨。.

programme.title: 喬太守亂點鴛鴦譜 / The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: 孫玉郎與劉慧娘，裴政與徐雅本是兩對情投意合的戀人，陰差陽錯間，孫玉郎男扮女裝代姊拜堂，劉慧娘則代兄娶妻。他們的婚約誤配，讓成誤會，終鬧上公堂，喬太守將錯就錯，乾脆來了一個亂點，結果正好有情人終成眷屬，皆大歡喜。.

programme.title: 喬太守亂點鴛鴦譜 / The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: 孫玉郎與劉慧娘，裴政與徐雅本是兩對情投意合的戀人，陰差陽錯間，孫玉郎男扮女裝代姊拜堂，劉慧娘則代兄娶妻。他們的婚約誤配，讓成誤會，終鬧上公堂，喬太守將錯就錯，乾脆來了一個亂點，結果正好有情人終成眷屬，皆大歡喜。.

programme.title: 太陰指 / Finger of Doom
programme.desc: 故事描述，路天保與兩個結拜兄弟，巧遇奉師命清理門戶的躺棺長髮少女與四行屍人...

programme.title: 梁山伯與祝英台 / The Love Eterne
programme.desc: 祝英台女扮男裝入學堂求學，並與同窗梁山伯結下至死不渝的深情厚愛。山伯得知英台真實身份後，立即前往祝家提親，豈料英台早已被許配他人，二人被迫含淚分離。山伯因悲痛過度，一病不起，最終含恨離世。英台驚聞噩耗，悲痛欲絕，哭祭山伯墳前，更縱身躍入墓中，以身殉情。.

programme.title: 武館 / Martial Club
programme.desc: 黃飛鴻與天壽武館之王隱林年少氣盛，得罪陸正甫武館少主及其騁用的高手單雄，從而掀起武館間的正面衝突。本片是劉家良導演最得意的作品，更是1981年十大賣座電影之一。.

programme.title: 八國聯軍 / Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: 清朝末年政局腐敗，社會民不聊生，慈禧太后與一群愚昧無知的權貴大臣不但毫無抵禦外國列強侵佔，以及保護人民的能力，反而迷信以吞符唸咒，自稱無堅不摧的「義和團」可以抵禦洋人，決意向列強宣戰。結果導致八國聯軍攻陷北京，慈禧太后倉惶逃難；人民這才醒悟到，只有孫中山先生領導的革命运動，才是挽救中國的唯一希望。.

programme.title: 錦衣衛 / Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: 明朝時，英宗昏庸無能，大權落入劉永飾的宦官之手，他利用锦衣衛誅殺異己；然梁家仁飾的锦衣衛統領卻義釋忠良。其父在宦官脅迫下被迫追殺親子...

programme.title: 香江花月夜 / Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: 本歌舞片由聲色藝各有千秋的何莉莉、鄭佩佩及秦萍合演三姊妹，再配以三大小生淩雲、陳厚及嶽華大鬥演技。由日本名演導井上梅次執導.

programme.title: 痳瘋怪拳 / The Tigress Of Shaolin
programme.desc: 鐵橋三發覺林縣官與鎮南醫局主持孟平勾結販毒，被追殺，幸得漁家女採嬌所救。採嬌乾爹醉公公介紹鐵到歐陽洪的雜貨店送貨，因而認識酒樓夥計老鼠仔。林與孟查知鐵下落，欲加害鐵，反而使歐陽洪無辜被害。鐵逃入海幢寺，得玄光大師傳授五郎八卦棍，遂與老鼠仔往找孟平報仇….

programme.title: 燕娘 / The Swordmates
programme.desc: 李飛龍要出行送鏢，行前囑咐好友王天彪代照顧自己的鏢局及妻兒，不料，天彪竟先誘姦飛龍之妻子，後殺鏢局眾徒，更伏兵襲擊飛龍一行人等。飛龍死裏逃生，請師侄英傑往保護女兒燕娘...

programme.title: 踩綫 / Murderer Pursues
programme.desc: 本片由著名演員王鍾編導，為 1981年的社會寫實電影。故事描述，呂良偉與李修賢在片中均為中越混血兒， 由越南逃至澳門；呂於香港出生，可在港居留，乃與李分散；鄭則仕飾呂之叔父，為一幹練警探，即介紹呂加入員警世界，派其作臥底。後鄭一次與越南匪徒糾鬥中 遭殺害；而李則被牽涉入這宗凶案...

programme.title: 寶蓮燈 / The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: 這是一個耳熟能詳之中國民間神話故事，講述書生劉彥昌巧遇落入凡間的聖母三娘，二人一見鍾情，結下一段仙凡姻緣。但因與二郎神結怨，屢遭迫害，二郎神更將聖母壓在華山底下。彥昌與聖母之子沉香長大後，聞悉生母被壓華山，悲憤欲絕，藉神斧之助挫敗二郎神，劈山救母。.

programme.title: 萬箭穿心 / Oath Of Death
programme.desc: 馬慶庭、向獨步、金梁義結金蘭，專與元軍作對。馬假意歸附元朝，獲封鳳陽鎮威大將軍，向、金火速進城，途中遇少婦沈衣霞，向娶之為妻。金催馬對元人採取行動，馬卻藉詞拖延。後來馬竟與沈有染，馬將向圍殺於城外，並冠以江洋大盜之名。金設計「萬箭穿心」，誓為向報仇…….

programme.title: 楊貴妃 / The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: 唐明皇十分寵愛妃子楊貴妃，導致終日尋歡作樂，荒廢國事，更將所有國事交貴妃之兄丞相楊國忠處理。丞相卻因貪贓枉法，暴虐無道，引起軍民共憤。民眾乘機造反要弒唐明皇，貴妃自知難逃一死，於是最終投繯自盡。.

programme.title: 流氓千王 / Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: 宗華與李修賢飾賭術精湛的流氓千王，李在澳門賭場被陳萍飾的千后擊倒後，遂回港與宗合作一雪其恥，出千騙財，開設豪華賭場，欲將陳誘得入局….

programme.title: Satu Mimpi Beda Profesi Satu Cinta
programme.desc: Untuk memenuhi kebutuhan hidupnya sehari-hari, Ines berprofesi sebagai penyanyi dangdut keliling. Pada suatu hari, Bara yang membuat kekacauan di acara Ines. Ia naik ke atas panggung dan mengancam para penonton. Ines bingung dengan keinginan pria muda tersebut yang marah-marah tanpa alasan. Ines kesal karena penontonnya pergi hingga ia tidak mendapatkan saweran. Kemudian, pria muda tersebut meminta Ines untuk membantunya menyelidiki ayahnya dan calon ibu tirinya yang saat itu sedang dekat. Awalnya Ines menolak, tapi dengan diiming-imingi uang dalam jumlah besar membuat Ines akhirnya bersedia. Ibu Ines kaget saat melihat Ines mendapatkan uang banyak. Ia mengingatkan Ines untuk tidak mencari uang dengan pekerjaan haram. Selanjutnya, Ines dan pria muda itu bertemu lagi. Mereka mulai menyelidiki ayah dan calon ibu tiri si pria muda. Si pria muda sangat yakin kalau calon ibu tirinya yang masih sangat muda hanya menginginkan harta ayahnya saja.

programme.title: Senyum Manis Berhati Sadis
programme.desc: Dekati pacar kembaran sendiri!! buat dia semakin nyaman & jatuh cinta. Clara tidak tau kalau pacarnya punya kembaran!! tapi dia hanya merasa perubahan drastis dari sikapnya. Ternyata kedua lelaki kembar ini dekati Clara hanya karena harta warisan. Apakah clara akan memilih cinta diantara mereka?

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah seorang gadis bernama Sakinah yang menjalani hidup penuh tekanan karena fitnah dan dipaksa menikah dengan orang yang tidak mencintainya. Tidak hanya itu, Sakinah bahkan dihalangi untuk tau siapa Ibu kandung yang tega membuangnya. Bagaimana kelanjutan kisah hidup Sakinah?

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Naik Ranjang
programme.desc: Setelah terpisah selama 20 tahun, Tyas berusaha mencari ayahnya, Mahdi, untuk menjadi wali pernikahannya dengan Gino. Setelah bertemu Mahdi, tunangan Tyas, Gino tampak terkejut menemukan Hani, adik Tyas yang telah memiliki anak dari hubungan mereka di masa lalu.

programme.title: Ayam Pop Kok Gak Bisa Nyanyi, Kenapa Sih Harus Boong
programme.desc: Noel tanpa sengaja nyaris menabrak seorang gadis pemilik ayam potong bernama Rea. Noel dan Rea terlibat percekcokan hingga membuat si gadis kesal karena ayam-ayam miliknya nyaris kabur. Beberapa waktu kemudian, si gadis dan si pria bertemu lagi. Kali ini orang tua Noel menyuruh anaknya untuk bekerja di peternakan ayam milik Rea.

programme.title: Hobinya Wara Wiri Suka Mampir Di Hati
programme.desc: Reno, anak manja yang tidak ingin menjadi CEO perusahaan, ia ingin membatalkan surat pengangkatan dirinya dengan mencuri berkas dikantornya. Nimas baru diterima menjadi security di perusahaan Reno dan ditugaskan menjaga Reno agar tidak kabur-kaburan.

programme.title: Pulang Sayang Nggak Pulang Makin Sayang
programme.desc: Jessica (Yuriska Patricia) yang merupakan anak orang kaya, tidak mau dijodohkan oleh orang tuanya. Ia malah berpura-pura menjadi seseorang yang bernama Anggi. Meski demikian, Jessica akhirnya mau dipertemukan orang tuanya dengan seorang pria yang dijodohkan dengannya. Ternyata pria itu adalah bos Jessica di kantor bernama Anggi (Ridho Illahi). Awalnya Ines menolak, tapi dengan diiming-imingi uang dalam jumlah besar membuat Ines akhirnya bersedia. Ibu Ines kaget saat melihat Ines mendapatkan uang banyak. Ia mengingatkan Ines untuk tidak mencari uang dengan pekerjaan haram. Selanjutnya, Ines dan pria muda itu bertemu lagi. Mereka mulai menyelidiki ayah dan calon ibu tiri si pria muda. Si pria muda sangat yakin kalau calon ibu tirinya yang masih sangat muda hanya menginginkan harta ayahnya saja.

programme.title: Naik Ranjang
programme.desc: Setelah terpisah selama 20 tahun, Tyas berusaha mencari ayahnya, Mahdi, untuk menjadi wali pernikahannya dengan Gino. Setelah bertemu Mahdi, tunangan Tyas, Gino tampak terkejut menemukan Hani, adik Tyas yang telah memiliki anak dari hubungan mereka di masa lalu.

programme.title: Ayam Pop Kok Gak Bisa Nyanyi, Kenapa Sih Harus Boong
programme.desc: Noel tanpa sengaja nyaris menabrak seorang gadis pemilik ayam potong bernama Rea. Noel dan Rea terlibat percekcokan hingga membuat si gadis kesal karena ayam-ayam miliknya nyaris kabur. Beberapa waktu kemudian, si gadis dan si pria bertemu lagi. Kali ini orang tua Noel menyuruh anaknya untuk bekerja di peternakan ayam milik Rea.

programme.title: Hobinya Wara Wiri Suka Mampir Di Hati
programme.desc: Reno, anak manja yang tidak ingin menjadi CEO perusahaan, ia ingin membatalkan surat pengangkatan dirinya dengan mencuri berkas dikantornya. Nimas baru diterima menjadi security di perusahaan Reno dan ditugaskan menjaga Reno agar tidak kabur-kaburan.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah seorang gadis bernama Sakinah yang menjalani hidup penuh tekanan karena fitnah dan dipaksa menikah dengan orang yang tidak mencintainya. Tidak hanya itu, Sakinah bahkan dihalangi untuk tau siapa Ibu kandung yang tega membuangnya. Bagaimana kelanjutan kisah hidup Sakinah?

programme.title: Kabur Aja Dulu Daripada Jadi Baper Mulu
programme.desc: Ratu mempunyai seorang kekasih bernama Fathan. Tanpa Ratu ketahui, diam-diam Fathan berselingkuh dengan sahabat Ratu. Pada suatu hari, Ratu syok saat mengetahui bahwa Fathan telah berselingkuh dan melamar sahabat Ratu. Hal tersebut membuat Ratu syok dan patah hati.

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Sok Petantang Petenteng Eh Malah Cut Off Sampai Asing
programme.desc: Senja dan Irina lagi jalan keliling kampus. Kebetulan mereka lewat ruangan Mapala. Di sana ada Bara, ketua Mapala yang banyak ditaksir mahasiswi kampus. Betul aja, Senja langsung jatuh cinta saat pertama kali lihat Bara. Saking terpesonanya lihatin Bara, Senja kesandung dan jatuh nimpa Langit yang kebetulan lagi duduk di situ. Siapa sangka, Senja dan Langit ternyata musuh bebuyutan sejak SD.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part III
programme.desc: Mr. Miyagi and his student open a bonsai-tree shop, then fight thugs sent by a millionaire toxic-waste dumper. Starring Ralph Macchio, Pat Morita, Robyn Lively.

programme.title: Resident Evil
programme.desc: A special military unit fights a powerful, out-of-control supercomputer and hundreds of scientists who have mutated into flesh-eating creatures after a laboratory accident. Starring Milla Jovovich, Michelle Rodriguez, Eric Mabius.

programme.title: Resident Evil: Apocalypse
programme.desc: Survivors (Milla Jovovich, Sienna Guillory, Oded Fehr) of a deadly virus must fight their way through Raccoon City's legion of undead inhabitants. Starring Milla Jovovich, Sienna Guillory, Oded Fehr.

programme.title: Resident Evil: Extinction
programme.desc: Survivors of the Raccoon City catastrophe travel across the Nevada desert, hoping to make it to Alaska. Alice joins the caravan and their fight against the evil Umbrella Corp. Starring Milla Jovovich, Oded Fehr, Ali Larter.

programme.title: Resident Evil: Afterlife
programme.desc: Joined by an old friend, Alice and her companions head to a rumored safe haven in Los Angeles but find it overrun with the walking dead. Starring Milla Jovovich, Ali Larter, Kim Coates.

programme.title: Outlander: Blood of my Blood
programme.desc: The Jacobite Army fights against the loyalists at the Battle of Sheriffmuir; men on both sides fight for their lives and for the future of Scotland, while Ellen and Julia face their own dangers; Colum holds fast at Leoch but doubts his resolve.

programme.title: Tip Toe
programme.desc: When Clive meets Diane, a chance of romance makes him confess long-held secrets; a shock discovery makes his war with Leo escalate, and both households hurtle toward danger.

programme.title: Madame Tutli-Putli
programme.desc: A stunning, stop-motion animated film that takes the viewer on an exhilarating existential journey. Starring Laurie Maher.

programme.title: Bollywood/Hollywood
programme.desc: A woman (Lisa Ray) pretends to be the girlfriend of a successful businessman (Rahul Khanna) in order to ease tensions in his family. Starring Rahul Khanna, Lisa Ray, Moushumi Chatterjee.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
programme.desc: Peter Parker's quest to solve his parents' disappearance puts him on a collision course with a scientist's deadly alter ego, the Lizard. Starring Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone, Rhys Ifans.

programme.title: Grown Ups
programme.desc: Friends and former teammates (Adam Sandler, Kevin James, Chris Rock) learn that age does not, necessarily, equal maturity when they reunite to honor the memory of their basketball coach. Starring Adam Sandler, Kevin James, Chris Rock.

programme.title: Grown Ups 2
programme.desc: Lenny Feder moves his family back to his hometown to be with his old friends and finds out that he didn't leave the crazy life behind in Los Angeles. Starring Adam Sandler, Kevin James, Chris Rock.

programme.title: The Mask
programme.desc: An ancient mask transforms a drab bank clerk (Jim Carrey) into a grinning Romeo with superhuman powers. Starring Jim Carrey, Cameron Diaz, Peter Riegert.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Three private detectives try to rescue a kidnapped computer pro whose voice-ID software would threaten global security. Starring Cameron Diaz, Drew Barrymore, Lucy Liu.

programme.title: Freaks
programme.desc: Sideshow performers punish acrobat Cleopatra (Olga Baclanova) for humiliating their friend, tiny Hans. Starring Wallace Ford, Olga Baclanova, Leila Hyams.

programme.title: Becoming Hitchcock -- The Legacy of Blackmail
programme.desc: Highlighting the birth of the Hitchcock Touch at a period when talking pictures first emerged and exploring trademark themes like murder, suspense and blondes.

programme.title: Blackmail
programme.desc: A Scotland Yard inspector (John Longden) deals with a blackmailer (Donald Calthrop) who knows that the lawman's fiancée (Anny Ondra) killed an artist. Starring Anny Ondra, John Longden, Donald Calthrop.

programme.title: The 39 Steps
programme.desc: Spies and the police chase a handcuffed couple (Robert Donat, Madeleine Carroll) who cannot stand each other. Starring Robert Donat, Madeleine Carroll, Godfrey Tearle.

programme.title: Dial M for Murder
programme.desc: A husband's plot to murder his unfaithful wife goes awry in Alfred Hitchcock's adaptation of the Frederick Knott play. Starring Ray Milland, Grace Kelly, Bob Cummings.

programme.title: North by Northwest
programme.desc: Mistaken identity spurs a foreign spy (James Mason) to pursue an innocent New Yorker (Cary Grant), all the way to Mount Rushmore. Starring Cary Grant, Eva Marie Saint, James Mason.

programme.title: Eva Marie Saint: Live From the TCM Classic Film Festival
programme.desc: An interview with Eve Marie Saint, concerning her life and career, taped at the TCM Classic Film Festival in April 2013.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: A fire-breathing behemoth terrorizes Japan after an atomic bomb awakens it from its centuries-old sleep. Starring Takashi Shimura, Momoko Kochi, Akira Takarada.

programme.title: Godzilla Raids Again
programme.desc: Prehistoric monsters Godzilla and Anguirus battle it out in Osaka, Japan. Starring Hiroshi Koizumi, Setsuko Wakayama, Minoru Chiaki.

programme.title: The Lost City
programme.desc: An evil scientist plots to take over the world after he invents a machine that causes earthquakes.

programme.title: Dr. Gillespie's New Assistant
programme.desc: The doctor (Lionel Barrymore) has a Kansan (Van Johnson), an Australian and an Asian from Brooklyn to choose from. Starring Lionel Barrymore, Van Johnson, Susan Peters.

programme.title: Looney Tunes
programme.desc: Sylvester Cat gets chased into Dr. Jekyll's lab by a pair of canines.

programme.title: The Barkleys of Broadway
programme.desc: Half of a husband-and-wife dance team (Fred Astaire, Ginger Rogers) wants to be an actress, so they split up. Starring Fred Astaire, Ginger Rogers, Oscar Levant.

programme.title: Lured
programme.desc: An American dancer (Lucille Ball) living in London helps Scotland Yard identify a murderer who preys on lonely women. Starring George Sanders, Lucille Ball, Charles Coburn.

programme.title: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
programme.desc: Gentle Dr. Jekyll (Spencer Tracy) tests a serum on himself, releasing vicious alter-ego Mr. Hyde on 19th-century London. Prowling the town, Hyde ventures to a music hall and encounters Ivy (Ingrid Bergman), whom he takes forcibly as his mistress. Starring Spencer Tracy, Ingrid Bergman, Lana Turner.

programme.title: Soylent Green
programme.desc: Future New Yorkers live on a trademarked food, which two detectives (Charlton Heston, Edward G. Robinson) find has a secret ingredient. Starring Charlton Heston, Edward G. Robinson, Leigh Taylor-Young.

programme.title: Rear Window
programme.desc: Sitting in a wheelchair, his leg in a cast, a photographer (James Stewart) spies on courtyard neighbors and sees a murder. Starring James Stewart, Grace Kelly, Wendell Corey.

programme.title: Paper Moon
programme.desc: A 1930s con man (Ryan O'Neal) teams up with a precocious 9-year-old (Tatum O'Neal) who could be his daughter. Starring Ryan O'Neal, Tatum O'Neal, Madeline Kahn.

programme.title: Chicago Syndicate
programme.desc: An accountant (Dennis O'Keefe) uses microfilm to nail a crime czar (Paul Stewart) for income-tax evasion. Starring Dennis O'Keefe, Abbe Lane, Paul Stewart.

programme.title: Summer of '42
programme.desc: A teen (Gary Grimes) falls in love with a lonely young woman (Jennifer O'Neill) and hopes to take the place of her husband who is away at war. Starring Gary Grimes, Jennifer O'Neill, Jerry Houser.

programme.title: Class of '44
programme.desc: Two friends (Gary Grimes, Jerry Houser) go to college and another (Oliver Conant) joins the Marines in this sequel to "Summer of '42." Starring Gary Grimes, Jerry Houser, Oliver Conant.

programme.title: MGM Parade Show
programme.desc: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films.

programme.title: The Night Digger
programme.desc: A blind Englishwoman's (Pamela Brown) spinster daughter (Patricia Neal) hides a killer handyman (Nicholas Clay) at their gothic mansion. Starring Patricia Neal, Pamela Brown, Nicholas Clay.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: The police and a neurotic woman's (Elizabeth Taylor) second husband (Laurence Harvey) do not believe she has seen a murder. Starring Elizabeth Taylor, Laurence Harvey, Billie Whitelaw.

programme.title: Chicago Syndicate
programme.desc: An accountant (Dennis O'Keefe) uses microfilm to nail a crime czar (Paul Stewart) for income-tax evasion. Starring Dennis O'Keefe, Abbe Lane, Paul Stewart.

programme.title: Singin' in the Rain
programme.desc: A silent-film star (Gene Kelly) loves a chorus girl (Debbie Reynolds) who dubs his squeaky-voiced co-star in a 1927 Hollywood talkie. Starring Gene Kelly, Debbie Reynolds, Donald O'Connor.

programme.title: To Be or Not to Be
programme.desc: Joseph and his acting troupe must confuse the Nazis and stop Professor Siletsky from handing over a list of Polish resistance members. Starring Carole Lombard, Jack Benny, Robert Stack.

programme.title: Night Song
programme.desc: A socialite (Merle Oberon) pretends to be poor and blind in her plan to help a blinded pianist (Dana Andrews). Starring Dana Andrews, Merle Oberon, Ethel Barrymore.

programme.title: Picnic at Hanging Rock
programme.desc: In turn-of-the-century Australia, three young schoolgirls wander away from a school picnic and become lost in the bush. Starring Rachel Roberts, Dominic Guard, Helen Morse.

programme.title: Witness for the Prosecution
programme.desc: An aging barrister (Charles Laughton) defends a man (Tyrone Power) for murder despite damaging testimony from the accused's wife (Marlene Dietrich). Starring Tyrone Power, Marlene Dietrich, Charles Laughton.

programme.title: Stage Fright
programme.desc: An English drama student (Jane Wyman) and her father help a young man (Richard Todd) accused of killing an actress's (Marlene Dietrich) husband. Starring Jane Wyman, Marlene Dietrich, Richard Todd.

programme.title: The Unknown
programme.desc: A fugitive posing as a circus performer goes to extreme lengths to win the heart of his lovely assistant. Starring Lon Chaney, Norman Kerry, Joan Crawford.

programme.title: Day of Wrath
programme.desc: In 17th-century Denmark, a pastor's (Thorkild Roose) second wife (Lisbeth Movin) is accused of being a witch after falling in love with her stepson. Starring Thorkild Roose, Lisbeth Movin, Sigrid Neiiendam.

programme.title: Ordet
programme.desc: Two sons of a Christian (Henrik Malberg) doubt their faith, while another (Preben Lerdorff Rye) believes he is Jesus Christ. Starring Henrik Malberg, Emil Hass Christensen, Preben Lerdorff Rye.

programme.title: Gold Rush Maisie
programme.desc: Maisie hears about a gold rush just outside a town, and decides to go into business with a family of poor prospectors and a crotchety ranch owner who may be unknowingly sitting on a valuable vein of gold. Starring Ann Sothern, Lee Bowman, Slim Summerville.

programme.title: Maisie Gets Her Man
programme.desc: Maisie (Ann Sothern) falls on hard times and works at several odd jobs before she meets aspiring comedian Hap (Red Skelton). Starring Ann Sothern, Red Skelton, Leo Gorcey.

programme.title: The Barbarian
programme.desc: An Egyptian-American woman (Myrna Loy) runs around Cairo with a desert charmer (Ramon Novarro) who turns out to be a prince. Starring Ramon Novarro, Myrna Loy, Reginald Denny.

programme.title: Love on the Sidelines
programme.desc: An unlucky woman, who aspires to be a fashion designer, falls into a job as personal assistant to injured superstar quarterback Danny, though she knows nothing about football. Starring Emily Kinney, John Reardon, Hayley Sales.

programme.title: The Love Advisor
